title: Country PMO Manager
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.


We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!


Job Description


**Position (Title):** Country PMO Manager


**Location of the position:** Gurgaon


**Job summary**

You will be responsible for driving program management, project reviews, critical stakeholder connects and other critical actions in driving and promoting country business strategy, working with the office of MD of RA India.


We expect you to understand the business needs and to demonstrate collaboration with the internal stakeholders/Business units to enable country business strategy (BSR).


You will report to the Regional Vice president\-Sales, India and work onsite in Gurgaon, India.


**Your Responsibilities**

This role would be primarily responsible for following:


**Drive execution of strategic priorities:** Own tracking and delivery of key BSR initiatives; ensure clear milestones, accountability and outcomes.


* **Governance \& IRC (schedule management):** Establish and run a regular operating rhythm (IRC, reviews, dashboards, and escalation forums) to maintain momentum across cross\-functional teams.
* **Cross\-functional orchestration:** Act as a central integrator across sales, BU, delivery, finance, HR, Marketing, GCCs and other global stakeholders to remove silos and accelerate decision\-making.
* **Executive decision support:** Summarise inputs into crisp insights, highlight risks/opportunities and prepare structured recommendations for MD review
* **Performance tracking and analytics:** Build visibility on initiative performance (KPIs, leading indicators), flag deviations early and lead corrective actions.
* **Special projects and transformation initiatives:** Lead high\-impact, time\-bound projects (e.g., operating model, productivity improvements, growth programmes).
* **Stakeholder management:** Interface with internal leaders and global teams to ensure agreement, communication.
* **Drive culture of accountability:** Reinforce outcome ownership, challenge slippages and institutionalise excellence.

**Critical qualities deemed essential.**

* Experience handling sensitive information following company policies and procedures and attention to data privacy requirements. upholding the decorum and status of the MDs office.
* Experience collaborating and communicating effectively with cross\-functional teams, senior leadership and executives.
* Knowledge of business and financial principles and their application to organisational goals.
* Collaborator with business teams/ functions and experienced at networking .
* Analyse complex situations, evaluate options, and make informed decisions that support our goals.
* Experience managing tasks and priorities while adapting to evolving our requirements.
* Proficiency in using relevant software and technology tools.

**Important deliverables/ success measures**

* Growth measured through execution of strategic projects.
* Follow programme management calendar.
* Impactful strategic briefings/ reports delivered.
* New c\-suite/ senior leaders relationships gained through influence.
* Incremental business brought because of RAs participation/ access/ influence in relevant forums.

**The Essentials \- You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's (Master's preferred) degree in Technology/ Engineering/ Business administration/ Political Science/ Public Relations/ Law.
* 10\+ Years of professional experience managing strategic projects/ Special projects and transformation projects
* Experience working in software/ technology companies at the leadership level.

**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have:**

* Experience in advocacy or public policy required.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes …


* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!

description:
**1\. Position Overview**

The Administration Officer is responsible for managing and coordinating all administrative operations of the institution, ensuring efficient functioning, compliance, and support for academic and non\-academic departments. * Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and maintenance staff.
* Oversee procurement of stationery, equipment, and administrative supplies.

**F. Compliance \& Reporting**

* Maintain statutory files, accreditation documents, and inspection\-related records.
* Prepare monthly/quarterly administrative reports for management review.
* Ensure compliance with institutional and regulatory guidelines.

* Bachelor’s Degree required.
* MBA/PG Diploma in Administration or HR preferred.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

* Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders efficiently.

description:
Job Description – HR Manager

Position: HR ManagerLocation: M R Enterprises, BhilaiDepartment: Human Resources

Job Summary

M R Enterprises is looking for a proactive and experienced HR Manager to lead all human resource functions across the organization. The role is responsible for recruitment, employee engagement, attendance and payroll coordination, statutory compliance, performance management, training, and HR policy implementation. The HR Manager will play a key role in building a disciplined, productive, and people\-focused work culture in a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Recruitment \& Onboarding

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for staff, supervisors, engineers, and workmen.
* Coordinate interviews, salary negotiations, and appointment letters.
* Conduct employee induction and onboarding programs.
* Maintain an updated manpower plan for all departments.

Employee Relations

* Foster a positive work environment and address employee grievances promptly.
* Promote employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Support disciplinary actions in line with company policies.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyze employee turnover.

Attendance, Payroll \& Leave Management

* Monitor employee attendance, shift schedules, and leave records.
* Coordinate payroll processing with the accounts department.
* Verify overtime, attendance, and statutory deductions.
* Ensure timely maintenance of employee records.

Performance Management

* Implement and monitor the employee performance appraisal system.
* Coordinate KPI setting and periodic performance reviews.
* Work with department heads to identify training and development needs.

HR Policies \& Compliance

* Develop, implement, and update HR policies and employee handbooks.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain personnel files and HR documentation.
* Coordinate statutory inspections and maintain compliance records.

Training \& Development

* Identify skill gaps and organize technical, safety, and behavioural training programs.
* Track employee training records and evaluate effectiveness.

Administration Support

* Coordinate with administration for employee welfare initiatives.
* Assist in organizing company events, celebrations, and employee recognition programs.
* Support implementation of workplace discipline and company standards.

Requirements

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum 5–8 years of HR experience, preferably in manufacturing or steel industries.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws, statutory compliance, payroll processes, and industrial relations.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS/ERP systems, and Microsoft Office.

Preferred Skills

* Experience handling blue\-collar and white\-collar workforce.
* Knowledge of PF, ESI, Bonus, Gratuity, Factory Act, and other labour legislations.
* Experience implementing HR policies, KPIs, and performance management systems.
* Strong problem\-solving and conflict resolution abilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely closure of open positions.
* Employee retention and reduced attrition.
* 100% payroll and attendance accuracy.
* Statutory compliance with zero major non\-conformities.
* Timely completion of performance appraisals.
* Employee training hours achieved as per plan.
* Employee engagement and satisfaction improvements.
* Accurate maintenance of HR records and documentation.

Working Conditions

* Full\-time position based at the manufacturing plant in Bhilai.
* Monday to Saturday working, with availability during emergencies or statutory inspections as required.
* Weekly off as per company policy.

Reporting To

* Director / Management

Core Competencies

* Leadership and team management
* Recruitment and talent acquisition
* Labour law compliance
* Industrial relations
* Communication and negotiation
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making
* Confidentiality and integrity
* Planning and organizational skills

Pay: Up to ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: HR Generalist
description:
**About Flexport:**
-------------------



At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.



The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

**About the role**
------------------



We're looking for an experienced HR Generalist, based in Mumbai, to own the full employee lifecycle and people programs across India and the Subcontinent. This is a true generalist role: you'll run recruiting end to end, manage onboarding through offboarding, and drive the HR operations, compliance, and employee\-experience work that keeps our teams thriving. You'll be the local face of the APAC People team, making sure our ambitious growth is supported by a robust and effective people strategy. We're building a People function that works smarter with AI, so you'll be encouraged to use modern AI\-powered tools to automate manual work, sharpen sourcing, and free up more time for the human side of HR.


**What You'll do**
------------------


* Own full\-cycle recruiting for a range of roles across departments—building search strategies, sourcing active and passive candidates, screening, interviewing, and guiding candidates through hiring and onboarding.
* Track sourcing data to focus effort on the channels with the highest ROI, and partner closely with hiring managers to attract, assess, and close top talent.
* Drive proactive recruiting initiatives and help build the Flexport employer brand across the region.
* Communicate candidate pipelines, funnel metrics, and performance data clearly and regularly to internal stakeholders.
* Serve as the local representative of the APAC People team, enhancing employee experience across the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding.
* Lead local HR operations including data management, employee support, reporting and analytics, process improvement, payroll support, and policy development.
* Maintain accurate HRIS data in Workday, run audits, and resolve employee tickets.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to automate repetitive HR tasks, source and screen candidates faster, and surface insights from people data.
* Act as the local expert on HR policy and ensure HR compliance across the region.
* Take on additional projects from the global and regional People leadership team as needed.

**What You'll bring**
---------------------


* A BA/BS degree and 6\+ years of experience, including full\-cycle recruiting at a search firm or fast\-growing company.
* A strong track record of processing a wide range of HR transactions and a solid understanding of HR best practices across the APAC region.
* Proven ability to build rapport with hiring managers and cross\-functional partners at all levels.
* A creative approach to finding great people, with the ability to build candidate networks and channel connections.
* A drive for results—you see processes through end to end and are motivated by data and metrics.
* Humility: no task is too big or too small.
* Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday (HCM, recruiting, or reporting) is strongly preferred.
* Comfort adopting AI\-powered HR and recruiting tools, with curiosity about how AI can make people processes faster and better.

#### **Commitment to Equal Opportunity**



At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


#### **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants**



Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

title: HR Executive
description:
Job Title: HR Executive

**Location:** Kirti Nagar, New Delhi  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented **HR Executive** to join our Human Resources team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end recruitment, maintaining employee attendance records, and supporting day\-to\-day HR operations. This role requires excellent communication skills, strong coordination abilities, and the capability to close hiring requirements within defined timelines.

Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for in\-house hiring requirements.
* Ensure all open positions are closed within the defined Turnaround Time (TAT).
* Make a minimum of **100 recruitment calls per day** to source and screen potential candidates.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media platforms, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Conduct telephonic screening, schedule interviews, and coordinate with hiring managers.
* Conduct telephonic and face\-to\-face interviews.
* Roll out job offers, negotiate with shortlisted candidates, and ensure successful joining.
* Manage the complete onboarding and induction process for new employees.

HR Operations

* Maintain accurate employee attendance records and ensure timely updates.
* Assist the Senior HR in day\-to\-day HR operations and administrative tasks.
* Draft and issue HR documents, including:
* Offer Letters
* Appointment Letters
* Experience Letters
* Confirmation Letters
* HR\-related emails and employee communications
* Maintain employee records and ensure documentation is complete and up to date.
* Coordinate with different departments to ensure smooth HR processes.

Employee Coordination

* Respond to employee queries related to HR processes.
* Support employee engagement and HR initiatives as assigned.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and HR procedures.

Desired Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–2 years of experience in HR recruitment and operations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple hiring requirements simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Google Space.
* Experience working with recruitment portals such as Indeed, LinkedIn, Internshala, Apna, etc., will be an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and meet hiring deadlines.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely closure of open positions within the defined TAT.
* Minimum **100 recruitment calls** made daily.
* Candidate joining ratio and offer acceptance rate.
* Accuracy and timeliness of attendance management.
* Timely issuance of HR documents and employee correspondence.
* Smooth execution of onboarding and induction processes.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: HR Manager
description:
We are a growing multi\-business group based in Madurai employing over 300 people. We are looking for an experienced Chief HR Manager to own the complete HR function across all our business units.

This is a senior, independent role. You will report directly to management and will be responsible for building and running HR systems, ensuring statutory compliance, processing payroll, designing performance frameworks, and developing our workforce. We need someone who can operate with minimal supervision and takes full ownership.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Recruitment \& Onboarding:**

* End\-to\-end hiring across all business units — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding
* Design and maintain induction process and probation tracking for all new joiners

**Payroll \& Compensation:**

* Monthly payroll processing for 100\+ employees across all units
* Salary structure design, advance and loan tracking, and full and final settlement
* Coordinate with accounts team for disbursement and ledger entries

**Statutory Compliance:**

* ESI and PF — monthly challan, employee registration, and claim coordination
* Professional Tax, Gratuity, and Bonus compliance
* Labour law compliance — Factories Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Minimum Wages Act
* Maintain statutory registers and ensure readiness for labour inspections at all times

**KPI \& KRA Framework:**

* Design and implement KRA and KPI frameworks for every role across all businesses
* Conduct quarterly performance reviews and compile reports for management
* Manage performance improvement plans for underperforming employees

**Training \& Development:**

* Identify training needs and design quarterly training calendars
* Deliver induction training for new joiners and coordinate external programs
* Build and maintain a skills matrix for the entire workforce

**Employee Relations:**

* Handle grievances, disciplinary matters, and exit interviews
* Maintain a positive work culture and manage attrition proactively

**HR Reporting:**

* Monthly HR MIS report to management — headcount, compliance status, attrition, training
* Maintain all employee records digitally — contracts, documents, performance history

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Mandatory:**

* MBA (HR) / MSW / PGDHRM or equivalent qualification
* 7–12 years of HR experience with at least 4 years in a manufacturing or industrial environment
* Hands\-on payroll processing experience for 100\+ employee headcount
* Strong knowledge of ESI, PF, Factories Act, and Tamil Nadu labour laws
* Proven experience designing and implementing KRA and KPI frameworks
* Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong Tamil communication; working English for documentation

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience managing HR across multiple business units simultaneously
* Familiarity with HRMS software — Zoho People, GreytHR, or similar
* Training facilitation experience — ability to conduct sessions independently

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Senior leadership role with full ownership of the HR function
* Exposure to HR management across three distinct industries
* Direct reporting to and visibility with senior management
* Stable, long\-term employment with a well\-established business group
* Performance\-based salary revision annually

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context** **Job Context:**  

Translate regional gold loan strategy into area execution plan while balancing rapid growth with strict risk discipline. This position execution of business initiatives, overseeing profit and loss statements, ensuring adherence to risk management and regulatory compliance, and leading teams to meet established targets. **Key Challenges:*** Driving rapid AUM growth while maintaining strict LTV norms, low NPAs and strong collateral cover amid gold price volatility.
* Ensuring zero deviation compliance with RBO guidelines across a large, distributed branch network without slowing business momentum.
* Preventing fraud, jewelry substitution, internal collusion and security breaches while scaling operations
* Improving performance of underproductive branches and optimizing fixed costs in a high volume, low ticker business.
* Protecting branch reputation by delivering transparent, fast and respectful customer experiences for a highly emotional asset.

* Disbursement Value (INR) Vs Plan

* Ticket Size (Avg Loan Amount)
* Growth Mix – New vs Renewal loans
  

Profitability \& P\&L Management – deliver profitable growth with cost discipline  

* Net Interest Margin (%)
* Yield on Gold Loan Portfolio (%)
* Cost to Income Ratio
* Operating Profit
* ROA / ROE
* Incremental Profit per branch
  

Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management – required to maintain superior asset quality and collateral safety  

* GNPA / NNPA (%)

* Gold Loan LTV (%) adherence
* Auction Loss (%)
* Fraud Incidence (No / Value)
* Recover Rate (%) post delinquency
  

Branch Productivity – build and optimize a high performing branch network  

* Number of new branches opened vs plan
* Break even time for new branches
* AUM per branch
* Disbursement per branch / per RM
* Low performing branch reduction (%)
  

Sales Effective \& Customer Acquisition – drive frontline productivity and customer reach  

* Disbursement per sales officers / BM
* Customer Acquisition cost
* Conversion ratio – lead to disbursement
* Repeat customer ratio
* Cross sell / Upsell Ratio
  

Compliance, Audit \& Regulatory Adherence  

* RBI / Internal Audit Observation
* Policy Deviation Cases
* Gold Purity Testing Compliance
* Documentation Accuracy
* Zero Tolerance Breach Incident
  

People Leadership \& Capability Building  

* Sales \& branch Staff Attrition
* Critical Role Vacancy TAT

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. * Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.

Working at Flutter is a chance to work with a growing **portfolio of brands** across a range of opportunities. We will support you every step of the way to help you grow. Just like our brands, we ensure our people have everything they need to succeed.

Our Hyderabad office, located in one of India’s premier technology parks is the **Global Capability Center** for Flutter Entertainment. A center of expertise and innovation, this hub is now home to over **900\+ talented colleagues** working across Customer Service Operations, Data and Technology, Finance Operations, HR Operations, Procurement Operations, and other key enabling functions.


We are committed to crafting impactful solutions for all our brands and divisions to power Flutter's incredible growth and global impact. With the scale of a leader and the mindset of a challenger, we’re dedicated to creating a brighter future for our customers, colleagues, and communities.


**Role Summary**

An exciting opportunity exists to join Flutter’s Internal Controls Assurance team. We are seeking to hire a talented Internal Controls Senior Manager to join the team. The ideal candidates will have experience working in a Business Controls function for a major multinational company or audit firm. The Flutter Internal Controls team is a key part of our governance framework and an important component of the second line of defense. A key Group\-wide function, it is responsible for promoting high standards of internal controls to reduce financial risk, delivering the annual internal controls testing plan, and providing guidance to the business on what robust controls look like. The roles involve providing an independent opinion on the design adequacy of the control framework and providing objective assurance to confirm that the controls are operating as expected.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Audit Planning \& Execution:


* Planning and execution of internal controls testing plan under the guidance of Business Controls Assurance Lead in accordance with defined quality standards and deadlines.
* Liaising with external auditors as required.

Team Management:


* Managing the team of Analyst, Senior Auditors and Audit Managers, ensuring their work is completed on time and supporting with any queries.
* Performing review of the testing performed by the team and providing guidance as required.
* Identification of skill gaps within the team and running formal/ informal trainings to upskill the team members.

Stakeholder Management:


* Identifying and communicating Business control deficiencies to management along with monitoring of management’s responses as well as implementation of agreed remediation plans.
* Continuously communicating with Internal Controls Senior Management on the progress to plan.
* Working with the Internal Controls Lead, internal controls colleagues including transformation and Finance / Business Heads, to improve internal control environment.
* Collaborate with the teams of other key internal stakeholders who have ownership of the processes to be tested, to deliver the Internal Controls plan and address concerns they may have.

**EXCEL IN THIS ROLE YOU NEED TO HAVE**

* Qualified accountant (ACA, CPA, ACCA, or CIMA)
* PCAOB audit experience of 10 to 12 years and experience in a professional services or industry role.
* Experience delivering ICFR activities day\-to\-day, across at least one whole financial year cycle.
* Experience of navigating material weakness or significant deficiency of remediation is advantageous, but not essential.
* Some experience of significant finance transformation activities in ICFR or with ICFR impacts, such as a GRC implementation, global process owner deployment, an ERP implementation, or technology enablement of the annual ICFR cycle, is advantageous, but not essential.
* Experience of betting, gaming or online entertainment businesses is advantageous, but not essential.
* Experience of Oracle ERP and related Oracle systems is advantageous, but not essential.
* Delivering the Internal Controls testing and assessments on time.
* Achieving an unqualified ICFR opinion from the external auditors for the year ended 31 December 2025\.
* Maintaining an unqualified ICFR opinion from the external auditors across the period of finance transformation, most significantly in 2026 and 2027\.
* Building the foundations for a culture where ICFR is seen as a critical part of the Group’s external financial reporting, and where roles contributing to ICFR are seen to be excellent progression opportunities into more senior finance roles.
* Good project management and organisation skills, to be able to manage the delivery of one or several workstreams to short\-term and long\-term deadlines.
* Good management skills, for directing the day\-to\-day activities of the internal and external support.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, to be able to clearly articulate the status of work and the risks that may cause timetable or cost challenges.
* Good ICFR skills, covering Business processes, is essential.
* Able to operate in a fast\-paced environment in a management role that is empowered to deliver change.

title: Global Payroll Specialist - Europe and Africa
description:
Envoy Global is a proven innovator in the global immigration space. Our mission combines our industry\-leading tech platform with holistic service to streamline, simplify and expedite the immigration process for employers and individuals.



We now have an exciting opportunity within Envoy Global's Human Resources team for an experienced **Payroll Specialist** to join us on a full‑time basis. This role is integral to ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll operations across multiple international regions including the **UK, Europe, and Africa**.



As a key member of the HR function, the Payroll Specialist will manage end‑to‑end payroll processing, maintain and analyze confidential payroll data, and serve as a primary payroll resource for employees across multiple countries. This position will work closely with our Payroll Manager, Country Managers, HRIS teams, and external vendors to ensure flawless payroll execution, adherence to country‑specific regulations, and exceptional employee support. The individual will also play a vital role in driving process accuracy, maintaining statutory compliance, and supporting key finance and HR initiatives across the organization.



**As our Payroll Specialist, you will be required to:**


* Monthly end to end payroll processing for UK, Germany, Kenya, Namibia and South Africa.
* Review and prepare multi country payroll monthly for hourly and salaried employees in accordance with Country, regional, and local laws, and standard accounting principles.
* Expertise\[JS2\.1]\[JS3\.1]\[JS4\.1] in handling multicurrency payroll for UK, European and African countries and exchange rates where applicable.
* Support our Payroll Manager with global payroll processes
* Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations. Process PAYE, NIC, student loans. Administer statutory payments. Year\-end activities P69,P11D,P45's
* Ensure compliance with local tax authorities in Africa, Manage local statutory deductions, pension funds, NHIF/medical schemes
* Maintain \& audit current payroll system for time \& attendance, employee records, etc. in preparation of payroll processing
* Partner with country managers and business HRs in the country to ensure all timekeeping tasks are completed, and support troubleshooting system issues
* Process voluntary deductions, garnishments, child support orders, tax levies, quarterly tax verifications, in accordance with all relevant laws
* Support tax\-related reconciliations
* Partner with HRIS, local vendors, tax authorities and payroll providers, where appropriate, to ensure payroll tax payment deadlines and compliance requirements are met in all jurisdictions
* Answer employee questions related to time and attendance, paychecks, deductions, and taxes
* Support Finance and HR teams with special projects and reports as required
* Region specific duties:  

 UK: Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations, processing PAYE, NIC, student loans, statutory payments and year\-end tax related activities  

 Africa: ensuring compliance with local tax authorities including but not limited to SARS, KRA, FIRS, ZIMRA, URA etc) as well as managing local statutory deductions such as PAYE, Social Security, Pension Funds, NHIF/Medical Schemes.
  


**To apply for this role, you should possess the following skills, experience and qualifications:**


* Working knowledge of the Country specific taxation, statutory and benefit related wage and hour legislation
* Experienced in MS Excel including V\-Lookups, Pivot Tables
* Experience with processing global payroll and liaison with vendors
* Ability to navigate through and learn HRIS/payroll systems quickly
* CPP or similar credentials preferred
* Able to work across time zones
* 3 to 6 years of experience processing payroll for a multi\-national employer, demonstrating knowledge of country specific payroll tax regulations, specifically experience in the UK, Germany and South Africa is a requirement.
* Graduation or above


***If this role excites you, please take a moment to complete the questionnaire below and attach your current resume. We look forward to your prompt response.***

As a key member of the HR function, the Payroll Specialist will manage end‑to‑end payroll processing, maintain and analyze confidential payroll data, and serve as a primary payroll resource for employees across multiple countries. This position will work closely with our Payroll Manager, Country Managers, HRIS teams, and external vendors to ensure flawless payroll execution, adherence to country‑specific regulations, and exceptional employee support. The individual will also play a vital role in driving process accuracy, maintaining statutory compliance, and supporting key finance and HR initiatives across the organization.



**As our Payroll Specialist, you will be required to:**


* Monthly end to end payroll processing for UK, Germany, Kenya, Namibia and South Africa.
* Review and prepare multi country payroll monthly for hourly and salaried employees in accordance with Country, regional, and local laws, and standard accounting principles.
* Expertise\[JS2\.1]\[JS3\.1]\[JS4\.1] in handling multicurrency payroll for UK, European and African countries and exchange rates where applicable.
* Support our Payroll Manager with global payroll processes
* Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations. Process PAYE, NIC, student loans. Administer statutory payments. Year\-end activities P69,P11D,P45's
* Ensure compliance with local tax authorities in Africa, Manage local statutory deductions, pension funds, NHIF/medical schemes
* Maintain \& audit current payroll system for time \& attendance, employee records, etc. in preparation of payroll processing
* Partner with country managers and business HRs in the country to ensure all timekeeping tasks are completed, and support troubleshooting system issues
* Process voluntary deductions, garnishments, child support orders, tax levies, quarterly tax verifications, in accordance with all relevant laws
* Support tax\-related reconciliations
* Partner with HRIS, local vendors, tax authorities and payroll providers, where appropriate, to ensure payroll tax payment deadlines and compliance requirements are met in all jurisdictions
* Answer employee questions related to time and attendance, paychecks, deductions, and taxes
* Support Finance and HR teams with special projects and reports as required
* Region specific duties:  

 UK: Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations, processing PAYE, NIC, student loans, statutory payments and year\-end tax related activities  

 Africa: ensuring compliance with local tax authorities including but not limited to SARS, KRA, FIRS, ZIMRA, URA etc) as well as managing local statutory deductions such as PAYE, Social Security, Pension Funds, NHIF/Medical Schemes.
  


**To apply for this role, you should possess the following skills, experience and qualifications:**


* Working knowledge of the Country specific taxation, statutory and benefit related wage and hour legislation
* Experienced in MS Excel including V\-Lookups, Pivot Tables
* Experience with processing global payroll and liaison with vendors
* Ability to navigate through and learn HRIS/payroll systems quickly
* CPP or similar credentials preferred
* Able to work across time zones
* 3 to 6 years of experience processing payroll for a multi\-national employer, demonstrating knowledge of country specific payroll tax regulations, specifically experience in the UK, Germany and South Africa is a requirement.
* Graduation or above

description:
**Content Writer**

**The Role \-** 

Most content roles end at the Google Doc. This one does not.

At Cidroy, you'll own the company's organic growth engine, from strategy and writing to rankings, AI visibility, and business impact. Success is measured by traffic, leads, and whether AI models cite us when buyers ask questions in our category.

We build mission\-critical software for high\-security, industrial, and enterprise environments where accuracy matters. Explaining complex technical products clearly, while making them discoverable through search and AI, is the core challenge.

You will own the company's content roadmap across every organic channel. You'll decide what gets created, what gets updated, and what gets removed based on performance.

**Who Should Apply \-**

Experience is not the deciding factor here.

If you can demonstrate exceptional writing, strong SEO execution, and the ability to own outcomes, we want to hear from you. Freshers who genuinely meet the expectations of this role are encouraged to apply alongside experienced candidates.

**What You'll Own \-** 

* Content strategy across the website, blog, product pages, documentation, case studies, and comparison pages
* Clear, technically accurate writing for technical buyers
* Brand voice across every content surface
* Content audits, refreshes, and pruning low\-performing pages
* Keyword research, search intent mapping, and content briefs
* On\-page SEO including metadata, internal linking, schema, and content structure
* Identifying technical SEO issues and working with developers to resolve them
* GEO and AEO through AI\-friendly content structure, entity clarity, FAQs, and schema
* Search Console health including indexing, sitemaps, canonicals, and coverage issues
* Performance reporting across GA4, Search Console, and social analytics
* LinkedIn, newsletter, and content repurposing across channels
* Community engagement where the audience already exists
* Prioritizing future content investments based on data

**Must Have \-** 

**Writing**

* A portfolio that demonstrates clear, high\-quality writing
* Ability to explain technical subjects accurately for an audience that includes engineers

**SEO**

* Hands\-on experience driving measurable SEO outcomes, whether professionally or through your own projects
* Strong understanding of on\-page SEO and enough technical SEO knowledge to identify problems and brief a developer

**Operating Style**

* Evidence that you own outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks
* Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly
* Ability to work independently without needing constant direction

**Good to Have \-** 

* Effective use of AI tools for research, drafting, repurposing, and automation while keeping the writing genuinely human
* Experience with CMS platforms, Markdown, HTML, and Git
* Basic design skills using Figma, Canva, or similar
* Startup experience or personal projects
* Experience growing a content channel, website, or audience from scratch

**What Strong Looks Like \-** 

* You read about a product or feature and come back with a content strategy, not a list of questions
* You can connect published content to measurable traffic, ranking, or business outcomes
* You remove content that no longer performs because the data supports the decision
* You turn one piece of research into multiple high\-quality content formats without repeating yourself
* You decide what should be prioritized next and can defend it with data

**This Role Is Not For \-** 

* Writers who only hand content off for others to publish or optimize
* Candidates who describe SEO in terms of tools instead of outcomes
* People who need a content calendar handed to them instead of building one
* Writers looking for a narrowly scoped execution role without ownership

**Why Cidroy \-** 

Cidroy builds software for defence\-adjacent, industrial, and enterprise environments where reliability is critical. You'll work directly with a technical founding team in a fast\-moving environment with real ownership, short feedback loops, and meaningful impact.

 At ANZ, we're applying new ways technology and data can be harnessed as we work towards a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

 Our community of over 5,000 engineers is key to making this happen, because technology underpins every part of our business \- from delivering tools, apps and services for our customers, to building a bank for the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Engineer, this role is responsible for designing and building data flow and storage solutions, as well as performing data collation, wrangling, analysis, and visualisation of datasets
   

  

 We’re seeking a talented Data Engineer to join the Customer Data and Analytics tribe within our Retail division.
   

  

 In this role, you'll design and implement data processing solutions that support analytics, reporting, and data development across the division. You will drive best practice data engineering, challenge inefficient practices, and influence change to improve business outcomes. Your work will focus on delivering end\-to\-end solutions, uplifting the data engineering capability within the tribe, and aligning with the broader Enterprise Analytics roadmap.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location:Bengaluru
   

  

 Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**
**What will your day look like?**
 As a Data Engineer, you will:
   

  

* Design data structures for data ingestion, integration and analytics layers on a variety of technologies
* Working in a cross skilled squad with people both from business and technology to build end to end features
* Contribute to design patterns for on\-premises and cloud.
* Optimise data flows by building robust, fault\-tolerant data pipeline that cleans, transforms, and aggregates unorganized and messy data into databases or data sources


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* MS or BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent practical experience in Data Engineering
* A strong background in data processing and software engineering and can build high quality, scalable data products.
* Designing data structures for ingestion, integration, and analytics across various technologies.
* Collaborating, contributing to design patterns for both on\-premise and cloud environments, and optimizing data flows by creating robust, fault\-tolerant pipelines that clean, transform, and aggregate messy data into organized sources.


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Electronics & Control Panel Assembly Technician
description:
Electronics \& Control Panel Assembly Technician

**Company:** Carbelim Private Limited  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Department:** Production \& Manufacturing  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** On\-site  
**Reporting To:** Production Supervisor / Manufacturing Engineer

About Carbelim

Carbelim Private Limited is a climate\-tech company developing innovative microalgae\-powered solutions for air purification, carbon capture, clean\-air infrastructure, wastewater treatment, and sustainable urban development.

Our products integrate mechanical systems, electrical control panels, electronic components, sensors, IoT systems, LED assemblies, and automated monitoring technologies.

Position Overview

Carbelim is looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented **Electronics \& Control Panel Assembly Technician** to support its production and manufacturing operations.

The selected candidate will be responsible for assembling, wiring, soldering, testing, inspecting, and preparing electronic products, electrical control panels, PCB assemblies, LED systems, and associated components according to approved production drawings, wiring diagrams, standard operating procedures, and quality standards.

The candidate must be able to perform precise assembly work while maintaining product quality, electrical safety, workplace cleanliness, and production timelines.

Key ResponsibilitiesElectronic Assembly

* Assemble PCBs, electronic modules, sensors, controllers, and related components inside product enclosures.
* Mount electronic components according to approved assembly drawings and production instructions.
* Perform soldering, desoldering, wiring, crimping, and cable\-termination activities.
* Inspect solder joints, connectors, terminals, and electronic assemblies for proper workmanship.
* Assist with the integration of sensors, IoT modules, display units, and communication devices.
* Ensure that electronic components are handled according to electrostatic discharge safety procedures.

Control Panel Assembly

* Assemble and wire electrical and electronic control panels according to approved layouts and wiring diagrams.
* Mount and connect components such as:
* Switch\-mode power supplies
* Relays
* Contactors
* Circuit breakers
* Terminal blocks
* Controllers
* Communication modules
* Sensors
* Display units
* Electrical protection devices
* Prepare and install DIN rails, wiring ducts, terminal markers, labels, and panel accessories.
* Ensure that panel wiring is neat, properly routed, labelled, secured, and easy to maintain.
* Verify wire numbers, terminal connections, polarity, and component placement before testing.

Cable and Wiring Preparation

* Prepare cable harnesses according to approved production requirements.
* Perform wire cutting, stripping, crimping, ferruling, soldering, and termination.
* Install cable glands, connectors, sleeves, heat\-shrink tubes, and protective coverings.
* Apply appropriate cable labels and terminal identification.
* Maintain organised and professional cable\-management practices.
* Check cable continuity and connection accuracy before installation.

LED System Assembly

* Assemble LED strips, aluminium profiles, connectors, drivers, and diffusers.
* Cut and prepare LED strips according to product dimensions.
* Perform soldering and wiring of LED assemblies.
* Install LED profiles and lighting components neatly inside product structures.
* Test LED brightness, polarity, electrical connections, and functional performance.
* Identify and replace faulty LED strips, connectors, or power\-supply components.

Testing and Quality Inspection

* Perform basic electrical continuity, polarity, voltage, and functional testing.
* Use basic testing instruments such as:
* Digital multimeter
* Continuity tester
* Power supply
* Soldering station
* Wire and cable\-testing tools
* Conduct visual inspections to verify assembly quality and workmanship.
* Check products for loose connections, incorrect wiring, damaged components, and improper mounting.
* Support product testing and troubleshooting under the guidance of the production or engineering team.
* Record test results and communicate identified defects to the concerned supervisor.
* Carry out rework or corrective assembly activities when instructed.

Production and Documentation

* Follow approved assembly drawings, bill of materials, wiring diagrams, standard operating procedures, and production instructions.
* Complete assigned production activities within the planned timeline.
* Maintain production, testing, inspection, and material\-usage records.
* Report component shortages, damaged materials, assembly defects, and production delays immediately.
* Coordinate with production, electrical, electronics, mechanical, quality, and engineering teams.
* Support product packing and final preparation when required.
* Assist with prototype assembly and product\-development activities.

Safety and Workplace Management

* Follow all electrical, production, and workplace safety procedures.
* Maintain electrostatic discharge protection while handling sensitive electronic components.
* Use personal protective equipment wherever required.
* Keep tools, components, wires, workstations, and production areas clean and organised.
* Handle soldering equipment, electrical tools, and testing instruments safely.
* Avoid material wastage and ensure proper handling of company tools and equipment.
* Follow 5S and workplace housekeeping practices.

Required Qualifications

Candidates should possess one of the following qualifications:

* Diploma in Electronics and Communication Engineering
* Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
* Diploma in Mechatronics Engineering
* Diploma in Instrumentation and Control Engineering
* Diploma in Electrical Engineering
* ITI in Electronics Mechanic
* ITI in Electrician
* ITI in Wireman
* ITI in a related electrical or electronics discipline

Freshers with strong practical skills and relevant academic project experience may also apply.

Required Technical Skills

* Basic knowledge of electrical and electronic components.
* Good soldering and wiring skills.
* Ability to perform cable cutting, stripping, crimping, and ferruling.
* Ability to read basic wiring diagrams, assembly drawings, and electrical layouts.
* Basic knowledge of PCBs, relays, power supplies, terminal blocks, controllers, and sensors.
* Familiarity with hand tools, power tools, soldering stations, and assembly equipment.
* Basic knowledge of digital multimeter operation and continuity testing.
* Understanding of wire colour codes, polarity, and terminal identification.
* Ability to identify common electrical and electronic assembly defects.
* Good attention to detail and commitment to quality standards.

Preferred Skills

* Previous experience in electronic\-product assembly or control\-panel wiring.
* Experience assembling electrical panels, automation panels, IoT products, or sensor\-based systems.
* Familiarity with LED\-strip assembly and installation.
* Experience in PCB soldering and electronic\-component replacement.
* Knowledge of cable harness preparation and cable management.
* Basic troubleshooting knowledge.
* Understanding of electrostatic discharge practices.
* Familiarity with 5S, production safety, and quality\-control procedures.
* Ability to communicate in Tamil and understand basic technical instructions in English.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* Technically skilled and interested in hands\-on production work.
* Careful and accurate while assembling electrical and electronic components.
* Able to follow drawings, instructions, and standard operating procedures.
* Disciplined in maintaining quality and safety standards.
* Comfortable working with tools, wires, control panels, and electronic systems.
* Organised and capable of completing assigned tasks on time.
* Willing to learn new assembly methods, products, and technologies.
* Able to work independently as well as part of a production team.
* Responsible when handling tools, materials, and company equipment.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Assembly accuracy
* Wiring and soldering quality
* Product quality and workmanship
* Production efficiency
* Rework and rejection reduction
* Compliance with assembly drawings and procedures
* Proper use of materials and components
* Workplace safety compliance
* On\-time completion of assigned tasks
* Cleanliness and organisation of the workstation
* Accuracy of production and testing records

Important Transportation Requirement

**Public transportation is not readily available near the office location. Candidates must have their own reliable mode of transportation and should be able to commute to the workplace independently.**

Applicants are advised to review the office location and confirm their daily transportation arrangements before applying.

What Carbelim Offers

* Practical exposure to electronics and control\-panel manufacturing.
* Opportunity to work on innovative climate\-tech products.
* Experience in PCB assembly, sensors, IoT systems, LED products, and electrical panels.
* Training and guidance from production and engineering professionals.
* Exposure to prototype development and commercial product manufacturing.
* Professional growth opportunities based on performance, skills, and organisational requirements.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may send their updated résumé to:

**hr@carbelim.in**

**Email subject:** Application for Electronics \& Control Panel Assembly Technician

Candidates should mention the following information in their application:

* Current location
* Educational qualification
* Relevant work experience
* Soldering and panel\-wiring experience
* Current and expected salary, where applicable
* Notice period or availability
* Mode of transportation

The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.
This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.


We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.

**Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2025\-2026 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

**It would be great if you also had . . .**

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

**What will you be doing in this role?**

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution

**About the Team**


The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.


Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.

* You will be working for works 40 hours/week (8 hrs a day; 5 days a week); you are entitled to get Overtime if you work beyond your working hours.
* This is a permanent job role.

description:
**Overview:** We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Digital Marketing Manager to join our dynamic team in the IT sector. As the Digital Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing digital marketing campaigns to promote our products and services, drive brand awareness, and generate leads. You will work closely with the marketing team, sales team, and others to develop and execute effective digital marketing strategies that align with our business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement digital marketing strategies to drive online traffic to our website, increase brand awareness, and generate leads.
* Manage all aspects of digital marketing campaigns, including email marketing, social media marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), pay\-per\-click (PPC) advertising, content marketing, and online advertising.
* Create and manage content for our website, blog, social media channels, and other digital platforms to engage our target audience and drive conversions.
* Utilize video editing and graphic designing skills to create compelling multimedia content for digital marketing campaigns.
* Monitor and analyze the performance of digital marketing campaigns using web analytics tools and make data\-driven decisions to optimize campaign performance and ROI.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and best practices in digital marketing, search engine algorithms, online advertising platforms, and multimedia content creation.
* Collaborate with the marketing team, sales team, and other departments to develop integrated marketing campaigns and ensure consistent messaging across all channels.
* Work closely with external agencies, vendors, and partners to execute digital marketing initiatives and achieve business goals.
* Manage digital marketing budgets and allocate resources effectively to maximize ROI.
* Maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and communicate regularly on the progress of digital marketing initiatives, performance metrics, and upcoming campaigns.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Proven experience in digital marketing, with a minimum of 3\-5 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in the IT sector.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, strategies, and techniques, including SEO, PPC, email marketing, social media marketing, and content marketing.
* Proficiency in video editing and graphic designing tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Adobe Photoshop, and Illustrator.
* Proficiency in using digital marketing tools and platforms, such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Mailchimp, and Hootsuite.
* Excellent analytical skills and the ability to interpret data, analyze trends, and make data\-driven decisions to optimize campaign performance.
* Creative thinking and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to develop innovative digital marketing strategies and campaigns that drive results.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively communicate with internal teams, external partners, and stakeholders.
* Leadership skills and experience managing a team of digital marketing professionals, providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help them achieve their goals.
* Passion for technology and the IT industry, with a desire to stay updated on the latest trends, developments, and innovations in digital marketing and content creation.

**Why Join Us?** If you're passionate about digital marketing and multimedia content creation with a strong background in the IT sector, we'd love to hear from you! Join our team and help us drive growth and success through innovative digital marketing strategies and campaigns. Apply now!

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates should send their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience with the subject line "Digital Marketing Manager Application".

Safety \& Compliance

* Follow institutional IT and laboratory policies.

* Support compliance with institutional quality standards.

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

* Time management
* Record keeping and documentation
* Customer service orientation
* Ability to work under pressure
* Attention to detail

**Sales \& Marketing Executive (Digital Marketing \& Lead Generation)**  
Mathure Metal Works Pvt. Ltd. \| Thane East, Maharashtra \| Full\-Time, On\-Site

**About Us**

Mathure Metal Works Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's leading manufacturers of brazing alloys, soldering alloys, and fluxes, with over 50 years of expertise since 1972\. We supply industry leaders including Whirlpool, LG, Godrej, and Tata, and we export across various countries. We were the first company in India to introduce non\-CFC brazing products and have trained over 15,000 shop\-floor professionals nationwide.

As we modernise and scale, we are building a dedicated Sales \& Marketing function — and we're looking for the right person to lead that journey with us.

**Why This Role Is Special**

This is a build\-from\-scratch opportunity. You won't be one voice in a large team — you will BE the marketing function. You'll own our digital presence, build our lead\-generation engine, and shape how a respected 50\-year\-old brand shows up in the modern world. You'll work directly with the Director and have a clear path to a leadership role as we grow.

**The Role**

Your mission is simple: make quality clients find Mathure Metal Works online, build trust in our brand, and feed a healthy sales pipeline. The Director closes the deals — you generate and manage the opportunities.

Your time will be spent roughly as:

* Digital Marketing \& Brand Building (\~40%)
* Lead Generation \& Sales Support (\~30%)
* Online Presence \& B2B Portals (\~20%)
* Reporting, Analytics \& Coordination (\~10%)

**Key Responsibilities**

Digital Marketing \& Brand Building

* Build and manage our LinkedIn presence — publish 3 high\-quality posts per week
* Run a content calendar: technical education, company milestones, client stories, factory content, industry trends
* Write and publish 2 SEO\-focused blog articles per month
* Grow followers, engagement, and reach organically
* Create marketing visuals using tools like Canva

Lead Generation \& Sales Support

* Generate leads via LinkedIn outreach, cold email, and digital campaigns (HVAC, refrigeration, automotive)
* Respond to inbound enquiries within 2 hours and manage a disciplined pipeline
* Maintain a CRM / lead tracker so no lead is ever lost
* Prepare brochures, product catalogues, pitch decks, case studies, and quotation formats
* Qualify leads and hand sales\-ready opportunities to the Director

Online Presence \& B2B Portals

* Manage and improve website content — product pages, blog, landing pages
* Optimise B2B listings (IndiaMart, TradeIndia, ExportersIndia, export platforms)
* Set up and monitor Google Analytics and Search Console
* Manage a WhatsApp Business profile

Reporting \& Analytics

* Weekly performance report to the Director
* Monthly marketing report (LinkedIn growth, website traffic, enquiries, leads)
* Use data to recommend where to invest more

**What We're Looking For**

Must\-Have

* Graduate in any discipline (Marketing / Mass Comm / BMS / BBA a plus)
* 1–3 years in marketing, digital marketing, business development, or sales support (strong freshers with a portfolio welcome)
* Excellent written English
* Comfort with LinkedIn, MS Office, and Canva
* Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) for content and research
* A self\-starter with an ownership mindset
* Strong organisation and follow\-through
* Based in or able to commute to Thane East

Good\-to\-Have

* B2B, industrial, or manufacturing marketing experience
* Basic SEO and website tools (WordPress, Wix)
* Google Analytics and B2B portals (IndiaMart, TradeIndia)
* Lead generation, CRM, or email marketing tools
* Hindi and Marathi in addition to English

**What You'll Gain**

* Complete ownership of the marketing function
* Direct mentorship from the Director
* A clear growth path to Marketing Manager and beyond
* Represent a 50\-year legacy brand with Fortune\-500 clients
* Performance incentives with a 6\-month review
* A genuine learning culture

**Compensation**

INR 2\.5 – 3\.5 LPA (based on experience) \+ performance incentives.

**How to Apply**

Apply directly through this posting, or email your CV to aum@mathuremetalworks.com with the subject line "Application – Sales \& Marketing Executive." A short note on why you're interested — and a link to any content, page, or portfolio you've built — will help your application stand out. We care about what you can build, not just your years of experience.

Biltrax Construction Data (biltrax.com) is India’s leading construction market intelligence platform tracking 1000s of projects covering Residential, Commercial, Retail, Hospitality, etc projects as well as other segments such as Industrial/Manufacturing, Warehousing, Roads \& Highways, Water \& Smart Cities.

Our company page on Linkedin \- https://www.linkedin.com/company/biltrax\-construction\-data/

Biltrax is led by Navin Rajpal, Managing Director \& CEO; after spending 15 years in the India \& United States Construction Industries. His profile can be found here \- https://www.linkedin.com/in/navinrajpal/

Biltrax works closely with Sales, Marketing, Strategy \& Management Teams of India’s leading Construction Material Manufacturers; typically the leaders in each product category.

Through our Data, Insights \& Analytics; these organizations are able to estimate the market size; rally their teams around those opportunities \& are able to realize thousands of crores in revenues annually.

Despite having the DNA of a startup, we are essentially a revenue/profit driven organization \& are the fastest growing in this segment over the past four (4\) years

Our visionary management team has ambitious plans to come up with multiple platforms \& create a mega\-impact on the Indian Construction Industry which is estimated to be worth over a $1 trillion in 2030\. To further fuel our growth, we are looking forward to recruiting best\-in\-class professionals for our teams

The key objective of an HR Recruiter is to attract, hire, and retain top talent for the organization while ensuring that the recruitment process is efficient, effective, and compliant with all relevant regulations.

* Responsible for sourcing, attracting, and hiring top talent for the organization.
* Identify potential candidates through various channels such as job portals, social media, and referrals.
* Create and post job descriptions on job portals, company career sites, and social media platforms to attract suitable candidates for the open positions.
* Screen resumes, applications, and cover letters to shortlist the most suitable candidates for further evaluation.
* Conduct interviews and evaluate candidates based on their skills, experience, and qualifications to determine if they are the right fit for the organization.
* Make job offers to the selected candidates after conducting reference and background checks by discussion with the HR manager.
* Promote the employer brand by creating a positive candidate experience during the recruitment process, including providing timely communication and feedback to candidates.
* Analyze recruitment metrics such as time\-to\-fill, cost\-per\-hire, and source of hire to identify areas of improvement in the recruitment process.

**Requirements:**

* Degree in HR BBA or Diploma in Human Resources Management.
* Salary Range: 13\- 16k

Job Description – Telesales ExecutivePosition

Department

Sales \& Business Development

Reporting To

Sales Manager / Business Development Manager

Location

Gandhidham / Ahmedabad (as applicable)

Job Summary

* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Appointments scheduled for the sales team.
* Lead\-to\-opportunity conversion ratio.
* Sales generated through telesales efforts.
* Customer follow\-up completion rate.
* CRM data accuracy and timely updates.
* Customer satisfaction and response time.

Personal Attributes

* Self\-motivated and target\-driven.
* Confident and persuasive communicator.
* Energetic with a positive attitude.
* Good listener with problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Willingness to continuously learn about fire safety products and industry standards.

As per company policy.

Compensation

Salary and incentives will be based on qualifications, experience, and performance.

title: Care Coach/ Care Coordinator
description:
**Job Description**

**Responsibilities:**

* Engage with the patients over various calls to understand their current medical health status, past medical/surgical history, medications taken, labs done etc.
* Understand if the patient has any additional requirements – medications, labs, dietitian, physiotherapists etc.
* To effectively engage the patients in giving complete medical history and determine if they have any deviations from the recommended treatment plan
* Provide patients with the psychosocial support needed to cope with chronic, acute or terminal illnesses
* Monitor patients to evaluate the progress of their health conditions and probe them in the correct direction in case of any alarming symptoms reported
* To smartly handle patient queries and provide responses from pre\-defined FAQs.
* Understand if the patient is compliant with Labs, Medications, and Diet \& coach them effectively in order to be compliant with the prescribed treatment plan as provided by their treating physician
* Develop and implement individualized care plans that address the unique needs of high\- risk patients.
* Provide continuous support, motivation, and education to patients through regular check\- ins via phone, video calls, and messaging.
* Educate patients on risk reduction strategies, healthy lifestyle changes, medication adherence, and self\-care techniques
* Provide wellness, lifestyle and diet tips wherever deemed necessary
* Proactively identify if the patient is showing any symptoms or deviation from his care path
* To collaboratively work with the Program Manager in identifying new trends, and new insights and effectively managing patient compliance

**Skills:**

* Excellent knowledge and interpretation of medical conditions and medical terminologies
* Effective Patient medical history\-taking skill
* Coaching the patient to be compliant with different medical parameters
* Excellent communication with clarity in speech; Ability to articulate and talk to the patient clearly without ambiguity
* Active Listening skills, being compassionate with the patients
* Passionate about the role and have patient care as a priority
* A natural conversationalist: Should be well\-read and can engage patients on a variety of topics. Pleasant disposition, naturally pleasing to talk and have a positive attitude
* Handling complaints and resolving grievances and conflicts that the patients might have Entering, transcribing, recording, storing, or maintaining information in written or electronic form
* Collaboration is key; should be a team player and can bridge the gap across all departments.

**What excites us:** 

· An investment in you as an individual \- we value traits like proactiveness, curiosity, empathy and the zeal to acquire new learnings and knowledge. We live these values by focusing on the well\-being, progress, and success of every individual in our growing company

· A good level of self\-awareness and humble confidence: You know your craft well enough to know your shortcomings and are open to making mistakes and learning together

· The ability to think and understand quickly

· A professional who has a proven track record of success in a client\-facing role along with managing high\-performing team members

· An Individual who is keen to explore \& demonstrates qualities of innovation \& strategic thinking

**What excites you:** 

· Own the process outcomes and the entire coaching delivery

· An ability to bring clarity and simplicity to an ambiguous problem space

· The platform to explore new opportunities \& contribute to various health coordination services

· Collaboration with cross\-functional partners \- for example, Quality, Product, Program Management and Compliance teams

· Ability to develop insights into patient behaviour, data change patterns \& other valuable clinical insights

· Direct patient interaction and opportunity to engage, change patient behaviours and contribute towards a healthy living

**Educational Qualification:**

M. Sc., Psychology (or) Counselling Psychology (or) MSW (or) M. Sc (Nutrition Science or Forensic Science).

B.Sc Nursing \- who are willing to do the patient counselling.

**Preferred Language:**

English \& Kannada are Mandatory. Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and any other regional language is beneficial.
