title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Field Sales Executive**

*Solar Energy Solutions (Rooftop \& Commercial/Industrial)*

**Department**

Sales \& Business Development

**Reports To**

Vice President

**Location**

Hyderabad (field\-based; daily travel across assigned territory)

**Employment Type**

Full\-time \| 6\-day week

**Experience**

0–3 years (freshers with strong communication skills welcome)

**Compensation**

₹20,000 fixed/month (based on experience) \+ uncapped performance incentives \+ fuel/travel allowance

**About the Role**

We're hiring energetic, target\-driven Field Sales Executives to sell rooftop, commercial \& industrial (C\&I) solar solutions to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. This is a high\-activity field role: you'll generate your own leads, run the sales cycle door\-to\-door and site\-to\-site, and close deals with support from our technical and design team. Candidates with field sales experience (solar, electrical, telecom, FMCG, insurance, real estate, or consumer durables) are preferred; strong\-communicator freshers are equally encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Generate leads through field visits, door\-to\-door canvassing, cold calling, local networking, referrals, and society/RWA outreach.
* Map residential, commercial, and industrial micro\-markets within the assigned territory to identify prospective customers.
* Conduct customer meetings to understand energy consumption, roof/land availability, and budget; explain product benefits, ROI, and payback period.
* Carry out preliminary site assessments and coordinate with the technical/design team for accurate system sizing and proposals.
* Prepare and present quotations/proposals; explain financing, subsidy schemes (e.g., PM Surya Ghar Mufti Bijli Yojana), and net\-metering process where applicable.
* Negotiate commercial terms and close sales against monthly lead\-generation and revenue/kW targets.
* Maintain and grow the customer pipeline; follow up consistently through to installation handover and post\-sale referrals.
* Log all leads, site visits, and follow\-ups daily in the CRM; submit accurate field activity and MIS reports.
* Track competitor activity, local pricing, and government policy changes affecting solar adoption.
* Represent the company at exhibitions, campaigns, and promotional events as required.

**Eligibility**

* Education: Any graduate/diploma; candidates with strong sales experience and minimum intermediate qualification may also be considered.
* Experience: 0–3 years of field/direct sales experience — solar, electrical, telecom, FMCG, banking, insurance, real estate, or consumer durables preferred.
* Freshers with excellent communication, confidence, and a willingness to do high\-activity field work are welcome.
* Must hold a valid driving license and own a two\-wheeler for daily territory travel.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong communication, negotiation, and consultative\-selling skills.
* Fluency in the local/regional language plus working English/Hindi.
* Self\-driven, resilient, and comfortable with high daily field activity and rejection\-heavy prospecting.
* Basic understanding of solar/rooftop systems and net\-metering (training provided).
* Comfortable with smartphones, MS Office, and CRM/lead\-tracking tools.
* Target orientation with the ability to independently manage a sales pipeline.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Fixed salary: ₹20,000 per month, based on experience.
* Incentives: Uncapped performance\-based incentives — high performers typically earn ₹10,000–₹30,000\+ per month in addition to fixed pay.
* Travel/fuel allowance as per company policy.
* Structured on\-the\-job training on products, subsidy schemes, and sales process.
* Clear growth path: Field Sales Executive → Senior Sales Executive → Team Lead → Area Sales Manager.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Number of qualified leads generated per week.
* Site visits and proposals shared per month.
* Lead\-to\-close conversion rate.
* Monthly sales value / kW capacity closed.
* CRM data hygiene and follow\-up turnaround time.

**Why Join Us**

Build a career in one of India's fastest\-growing sectors. You'll get uncapped earning potential, structured training, and a clear path into senior sales and territory\-management roles as the renewable energy market scales.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

description:
Job description:

The Sales Staff is responsible for providing excellent customer service, achieving sales targets, maintaining product displays, handling billing, and ensuring the store remains clean, organized, and fully stocked. The role requires a friendly attitude, product knowledge, and the ability to create a positive shopping experience for every customer.

Key Responsibilities1\. Customer Service

* Welcome every customer with a smile and offer assistance.

* Handle customer complaints politely and escalate issues when necessary.

* Receive and confirm cake orders accurately.
* Record customer details and delivery/pickup timings.
* Coordinate with the production team for customized orders.

* Cooperate with colleagues to ensure smooth store operations.
* Support new employees during training.
* Follow instructions from the Store Incharge or Branch Manager.
* Maintain a positive and professional attitude.

Daily Duties

* Verify cleanliness before opening.
* Attend customers promptly.
* Complete billing accurately.
* Refill products throughout the day.

* Count cash and close the billing system at the end of the shift.

* Daily sales achievement

* Upselling and cross\-selling performance
* Customer satisfaction
* Billing accuracy
* Cash handling accuracy
* Attendance and punctuality
* Store cleanliness and presentation
* Product wastage control
* Customer feedback and repeat visits

Qualifications

* Higher Secondary (Plus Two) or above
* Diploma or degree is an added advantage

Experience

* Freshers are welcome.

Skills Required

* Excellent communication skills
* Customer service orientation
* Sales and persuasion skills
* Basic computer and POS knowledge
* Cash handling ability
* Teamwork
* Time management
* Problem\-solving skills
* Positive attitude and professional appearance

Working Hours

* As per company shift schedule.
* Willingness to work weekends, holidays, and festival seasons.

Code of Conduct

* Be punctual and maintain regular attendance.
* Wear the prescribed uniform and ID card.
* Maintain personal hygiene and grooming.
* Be polite and respectful to customers and colleagues.

Bank Follow\-up Officer (BFO)

**Company:** Loanitol (Dr Cube Financial Consultancy Private Limited)  
**Location:** Palarivattom, Kochi, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years (Experience in Banking, Loan Processing, DSA, NBFC, or Financial Services preferred)

About the Role

Loanitol is looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented **Bank Follow\-up Officer (BFO)** to manage end\-to\-end coordination with banks and financial institutions for loan processing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth movement of loan applications from login to disbursement while maintaining excellent relationships with banking partners and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate with banks, Relationship Managers (RMs), Credit Managers, Branch Managers, and Operations teams for smooth loan processing.
* Track loan applications from login to sanction and final disbursement.
* Follow up regularly with banks to reduce processing delays and improve turnaround time (TAT).
* Coordinate with customers and internal departments to collect documents and resolve queries.
* Verify customer documentation including KYC, financial statements, GST returns, Income Tax Returns, bank statements, and property documents.
* Coordinate legal verification, technical inspections, and valuation activities for secured loan cases.
* Monitor sanction conditions and ensure timely completion of pre\-disbursement formalities.
* Maintain accurate case records, CRM updates, MIS reports, and loan status reports.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with banking partners and financial institutions.
* Follow up on consultancy fee collections and bank payout receivables.
* Ensure confidentiality of customer information and compliance with company policies.
* Stay updated on banking policies, loan products, and industry developments.
* Support knowledge\-sharing and training initiatives within the team.

Required Qualifications

* Master's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Finance, Banking, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in loan processing, banking operations, DSA, NBFC, or financial services.
* Freshers with exceptional communication skills and a strong willingness to learn may also apply.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and negotiation skills
* Excellent follow\-up and coordination abilities
* Knowledge of secured and unsecured loan processes
* Understanding of banking documentation and credit processes
* Familiarity with GST, Income Tax Returns, and financial statements
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and CRM software
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to work under pressure and meet turnaround time (TAT) targets

Why Join Loanitol?

* Opportunity to work with leading banks and financial institutions.
* Exposure to a wide range of retail and business loan products.
* Professional learning and career growth in the financial services industry.
* Performance\-driven work culture with growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.

**Role Summary**

Proofreaders at Educart are responsible for identifying and correcting grammatical, typographical, formatting, and technical errors in written documents by comparing them with the original manuscripts. * Ensure page numbering is accurate and no pages are repeated or missing.
* Check whether chapter titles match the table of contents.
* Ensure illustrations, captions, and references are accurate and properly placed.
* Stay updated with grammatical developments and language terminology.
* Coordinate with authors and editors to clarify language or formatting inconsistencies.
* Forward finalized proofread materials for approval and publication.

* Excellent attention to detail and time management skills.

The Assistant Manager – Accounts is responsible for managing the day\-to\-day accounting operations of the hospital, ensuring accurate financial reporting, statutory compliance, doctor payout processing, revenue reconciliation, and internal financial controls. The role requires strong expertise in hospital accounting, consultant doctor remuneration, GST, TDS, MIS reporting, audits, and ERP\-based financial systems.

Key ResponsibilitiesDoctor Payout Management

* Process monthly consultant doctor payouts as per agreements and approved payout models.
* Calculate fixed, revenue\-sharing, incentive\-based, and procedure\-wise payouts.
* Verify OP/IP revenue, surgery revenue, diagnostics, and package collections before payout.
* Reconcile consultant revenue with Hospital Information System (HIS) and ERP.
* Ensure accurate deduction of TDS and other statutory deductions.
* Resolve payout discrepancies in coordination with Medical Administration, Billing, and Consultants.
* Maintain consultant agreements and payout records.
* Generate monthly doctor payout statements and MIS reports.

Accounting \& Finance

* Manage General Ledger (GL), journal entries, and account reconciliations.
* Review Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
* Monitor bank reconciliations and cash flow.
* Ensure timely month\-end and year\-end closing activities.
* Prepare financial statements and schedules.
* Monitor revenue leakage and implement financial controls.

Revenue \& Billing

* Reconcile hospital billing with collections.
* Verify package billing, discounts, refunds, and credit notes.
* Coordinate with billing and operations to resolve revenue mismatches.
* Monitor outstanding receivables.

Statutory Compliance

* Ensure timely filing of GST, TDS, Professional Tax, and other statutory compliances.
* Coordinate with auditors during Internal, Statutory, GST, and Tax Audits.
* Ensure compliance with Income Tax provisions applicable to consultant payments.

MIS \& Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Analyze revenue trends, consultant productivity, payout variance, and departmental profitability.
* Present financial reports to management.
* Support Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and budgeting activities.

Internal Controls

* Implement SOPs for financial processes.
* Ensure compliance with internal financial controls and audit requirements.
* Monitor expense controls and budget utilization.
* Identify process improvement opportunities.

Team Coordination

* Coordinate with Billing, Medical Administration, HR, Operations, Purchase, and Consultants.
* Guide junior accounts executives.
* Support automation and ERP implementation initiatives.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce (B.Com)
* MBA (Finance), M.Com, CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent qualification preferred.

Experience

* 5–8 years of experience in Hospital Finance \& Accounts.
* Minimum 3 years of experience handling Consultant Doctor Payouts.
* Experience in NABH\-accredited hospitals preferred.
* Experience with multi\-specialty hospitals is an advantage.

Technical Skills

* Hospital Information Systems (HIS)
* ERP Software (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Tally Prime, etc.)
* Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, Power Query preferred)
* Financial Reporting
* GST \& TDS Compliance
* Budgeting \& Forecasting
* MIS Reporting
* Bank Reconciliation
* Doctor Revenue Sharing Models

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

description:

**About Signify**

  

  

Through bold discovery and cutting\-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.

  

  

At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125\+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.

  

  

Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.

  

  

**More about the role**

  

  

**Job Summary**


Provides specialized advice to line managers on HR management processes. Advises on HR policies and practices for effective people management.


Key Areas of Responsibility
  

* Provides specialized advice to line managers on HR management processes and assists them with HR policies and practices.
* Advises line managers on people management issues, complex HR processes, offboarding and legal boundaries.
* Supports managers with illness, absence, terminations, and disciplinary actions.
* Manages complex cases regarding employee contracting, compliance and ethics.
* Applies reward policies, payroll, and benefit management.
* Handles reporting and analytics.
* Supports HRBP's with application of HR interventions.
* Advises line managers in collecting information, processing data, or handling paperwork for complex transactional activities or system support, while straightforward cases go through the contact center.
* Drives continuous standardization and improvements in working methods, including addressing communication and portal content for further standardization.
* Suggests policy improvements to the local Center of Excellence based on day\-to\-day experience and supports translating policy and legal design into processes deliverable by HR Services.
* Act as escalation point to coordinate resolution of complex individual employee matters.

Critical Experiences
  

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3\-5 years of experience in HR advisory roles, with a focus on employee relations, HR policies, and legal compliance.
* Certification in Human Resources is highly recommended to ensure understanding of HR practices and legal requirements.
  

  

**Everything we’ll do for you**

  

  

You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000\+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70\+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.

  

  

Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: Senior Benefits Analyst
description:
**About the team**
------------------

The Senior Benefits Analyst will be an integral operational partner to the U.S.\-based Benefits Team. Based in India, this role supports the accurate, compliant, and efficient delivery of our benefits programs — from day\-to\-day administration and employee support to data integrity, compliance, and reporting.
  

You will also partner closely with the Benefits Program Managers to support benefits administration across our locations\- U.S, Mexico, India, Germany, Canada, and Serbia. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role within our GCC and an opportunity to grow deep expertise in global benefits operations.
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.


**About the role**
------------------

### **Benefits Administration**

* Administer employee benefits programs across health, welfare, retirement, and ancillary plans, ensuring accuracy and a positive employee experience.
* Process enrollment transactions, qualifying life events, and employee data changes in the HRIS; partner with carriers and vendors to resolve discrepancies.
* Serve as a Tier 3 resource for employee benefits inquiries, providing clear and timely guidance on plan provisions, eligibility, and enrollment processes.
* Assist with benefits billing processes, including data validation and submission support; U.S. team retains payment authorization.
* Partner with the Global Benefits Program Manager to support international benefits administration across multiple countries, including enrollment coordination, billing reconciliation, and carrier data management.
* Support routine plan administration tasks for international programs, including data pulls, eligibility tracking, and audit support.

### **Compliance \& Audit**

* Support the preparation and coordination of recurring U.S. benefits compliance obligations, including annual filings, regulatory reporting, and plan documentation.
* Execute a portfolio of recurring data audits across benefit programs to ensure enrollment accuracy, eligibility integrity, and data quality.
* Prepare audit documentation, organize supporting materials, and manage audit checklists; escalate findings and flag discrepancies to the U.S. team for resolution.
* Monitor ongoing compliance obligations and proactively surface issues to the appropriate U.S. owner.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
**Who you are**
---------------

* Detail\-oriented and process\-driven. You take ownership of complex, multi\-step processes and execute them with precision and consistency.
* Proactive and accountable. You identify issues before they become problems, escalate clearly with documented findings, and follow through to resolution.
* Collaborative. You work seamlessly across time zones, building trust with U.S. counterparts through reliable communication and dependable follow\-through.
* Analytically minded. You’re comfortable working with data across HRIS and vendor platforms — pulling reports, spotting anomalies, and organizing findings clearly.
* Effective in Cloud HQ. You thrive in a remote, asynchronous environment, communicate clearly in writing, and build trust without in\-person presence.
* Curious about the ‘why’. You want to understand the context behind the work, not just complete tasks — and you ask questions when something doesn’t add up.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 4\+ years of experience in benefits administration, HR operations, or a related field
* Experience administering health, welfare, and/or retirement benefit programs
* Familiarity with benefits compliance concepts and regulatory obligations is a strong plus
* Experience supporting global or international benefits programs preferred
* Proficiency with Workday or a comparable HRIS; comfortable running reports and processing benefit transactions
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for data reconciliation and reporting
* Excellent written communication skills in English; able to communicate clearly with employees, vendors, and global counterparts
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, asynchronous, remote environment

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.


As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.


Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

title: HR Manager, India
description:
**Role purpose**
 Our people are our most important asset and it is the role of the HR Manager to support the business in providing a happy and productive workplace where everyone can work to their full potential, feel included in the workplace and engaged with the business.
   

  

 The HR Manager, India is responsible for delivering a compliant, commercially focused and high\-quality HR service across the region. Acting as the key escalation point from the HR Shared Service Centre, the role leads on complex employee relations matters, ensures adherence to local labour laws, and provides data\-driven insight on employee sentiment and engagement to inform business decisions.
   

  

 The role works in close partnership with HR Business Partners, focusing on local delivery, employee relations expertise, and in\-country insight.
   

  

 The role partners with regional and global HR teams to ensure India requirements are represented in projects, policies, and initiatives, while continuously improving the employee experience in\-market.
   

  

**Role Tasks And Responsibilities**
 Employee Experience, Engagement \& Insight
   

  

  Build a strong understanding of employee sentiment, engagement levels, and retention drivers across India
   

  

  Complete exit interviews with senior employees and analyse data across all employee exits in India capturing valuable insight and making recommendations for improvements
   

  

  Analyse local data (e.g. engagement surveys, attrition trends, ER cases) to identify themes and risks
   

  

  Recommend and drive targeted initiatives to improve engagement, inclusion, and overall employee experience
   

  

  Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on people\-related challenges and opportunities
   

  

 Employee Relations and Case Management
   

  

  Act as key interface between the HR Shared Service Centre (SSC) and the India business
   

  

  Ensure effective handling and resolution of escalated queries, maintaining service quality and timeliness
   

  

  Act as the primary escalation point for complex employee relations cases, taking responsibility to manage sensitive and high\-risk cases (disciplinary, grievance, performance, exits) ensuring consistency, fairness, and legal compliance
   

  

  Provide feedback to the SSC on recurring issues, process gaps, and improvement opportunities based on trends in case data
   

  

  Support continuous improvement of HR processes, service delivery, and knowledge management
   

  

 Compliance \& Local Employment Law
   

  

  Ensure compliance with all applicable India labour laws and regulations, including ongoing monitoring of legislative changes
   

  

  Translate local legal requirements into practical HR policies, processes, and guidance for the business
   

  

  Support audits, risk mitigation, and documentation standards in line with statutory requirements
   

  

  Identify, assess, and mitigate people\-related risks, escalating issues where required to protect the organisation from legal and reputational exposure
   

  

  Partner with legal (internal/external) on complex or high\-risk employment matters
   

  

  Provide oversight and guidance on immigration and visa\-related matters where required
   

  

 Business Partnering \& Stakeholder Support
   

  

  Develop effective working relationships with local leadership to support delivery of business objectives
   

  

  Provide input on organisational changes, workforce planning, and talent considerations from an India perspective
   

  

  Coach and support line managers in building strong, engaged, and compliant teams
   

  

  Support change initiatives, ensuring appropriate communication and local alignment
   

  

  Provide expert guidance and coaching to managers on ER matters and local employment legislation
   

  

  Work closely with the Talent Development Manager to ensure training programs are carried out on the ground as per the global/regional training agenda

title: Senior Business Development Specialist – Enterprise HR & L&D Solutions
description:
**About the Role**

Our client is a Bengaluru\-based leadership development firm that designs and delivers flagship, high\-touch learning journeys for frontline and mid\-level managers of leading enterprise organisations. These are outcome\-driven, high\-ticket programs sold to senior HR decision\-makers — not off\-the\-shelf training.

We are looking for a refined, articulate senior sales professional who has already sold HR / L\&D / training solutions to enterprise clients, and who can hold a credible, consultative conversation with CHROs, HR Heads, L\&D Heads, and OD leaders — connecting the cost of untrained managers to business outcomes, generating qualified opportunities, and carrying them through to closure.

**Who This Role Is For (Read Before Applying)**

**This is a specialist role. We will only consider candidates who meet ALL of the following:**

* **Enterprise HR/L\&D solution sales experience.** A minimum of 3 years selling L\&D, leadership development, corporate training, talent development, HR consulting, or assessment solutions to enterprise or large mid\-market organisations. Your CV must name the solutions you sold and the buyer personas you sold to.
* **Direct experience selling to HR / L\&D / OD leadership.** You have personally prospected into, and held consultative discovery conversations with, CHROs, HR Heads, L\&D Heads, and OD leaders — and can speak to specific accounts and conversations in an interview.
* **Full\-cycle ownership.** You have both generated qualified opportunities AND closed them, ideally high\-ticket services (₹10L\+ engagements) with 4–12 week sales cycles. A purely SDR / appointment\-setting background does not qualify.
* **Polished communication.** Excellent spoken and written English; poised, articulate, and credible in CXO\-level conversations.
* **Tool fluency.** Hands\-on with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email outreach tools, and a CRM (HubSpot / Zoho / Salesforce or similar).

**This role is NOT a fit if your experience is primarily in:** B2C / edtech counselling sales, telesales or telecalling, recruitment / staffing BD, generic IT or SaaS sales without HR/L\&D buyer exposure, or pure lead\-generation / SDR roles. Applications from these backgrounds will not be processed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Prospecting \& Pipeline Generation**

* Build and maintain a targeted database of CHROs, HR Heads, L\&D Heads, and OD leaders across priority industries and enterprise accounts.
* Run structured outbound campaigns (calls, email sequences, LinkedIn outreach, nurture mailers) using program\-specific messaging and research\-backed insights such as manager\-effectiveness data and cost\-of\-inaction framing.
* Follow up on inbound enquiries, webinar/event registrants, and marketing\-generated leads promptly and professionally.

**Consultative Conversations \& Qualification**

* Engage senior HR stakeholders in discovery conversations: understand their manager\-capability challenges, current L\&D initiatives, budgets, and decision processes.
* Position the firm’s flagship manager\-development programs in the context of the client’s business problem — attrition, first\-time\-manager transitions, engagement, leadership pipeline — rather than as generic training.
* Qualify opportunities rigorously (need, budget, authority, timeline) and maintain accurate opportunity stages.

**Opportunity Progression \& Closure**

* Set up and co\-anchor discovery and proposal meetings with the founder/delivery team; prepare pre\-meeting briefs on the account and stakeholders.
* Drive proposals, customisation discussions, commercial negotiations, and follow\-through to signed engagement.
* Own the lead\-to\-closure journey for assigned opportunities across typically 4–12 week B2B sales cycles.

**CRM, Reporting \& Market Intelligence**

* Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene: activities, pipeline stages, forecasts, and win/loss notes; report weekly on outreach metrics, qualified opportunities, pipeline value, and conversion.
* Track competitor offerings, industry L\&D trends, and client\-side triggers (new CHRO hires, expansion, restructuring) to time outreach.

**Good to Have**

* Existing relationships or network within HR/L\&D communities (NHRDN, SHRM, CII HR forums, L\&D circles).
* Understanding of leadership development concepts: first\-time manager transitions, learning journeys, behavioural change measurement, ROI of training.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in HR / Marketing (preferred, not mandatory).

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* A healthy, self\-generated pipeline of qualified opportunities with target enterprise accounts.
* Consistent achievement of monthly qualified\-meeting and quarterly closure targets (finalised jointly).
* Recognised by clients as a knowledgeable, trusted first point of contact — a solution advisor, not a telecaller.

**Compensation**

* Fixed \+ performance\-linked variable, competitive with market benchmarks for senior consultative enterprise sales roles in Bangalore. Details discussed at interview.
* Clear incentive structure linked to qualified opportunities and closed revenue.

**Why Join Us**

* Sell programs with genuine depth and differentiation — dialogue\-based, application\-driven learning journeys with measurable behavioural impact, not commodity training.
* Direct access to founders and program design; your client insights shape the offering.
* High\-trust, high\-ownership environment with room to grow into a business development leadership role.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

title: Export Sales Intern
description:
**Company:** Handmada  
**Location:** Rajkot/Morbi, Gujarat, India  
**Department:** International Sales \& Business Development  
**Reports To:** Export Sales Manager  
**Team:** Works alongside other Export Sales Executives; may mentor Export Sales Interns

About Handmada

Handmada is a global supply group based in Morbi, India, combining manufacturing experience with carefully managed supplier partnerships across tiles, SPC, ceramic fiber \& brick, FIBC bags, slabs, sanitary ware, rope, cotton, brass products, kitchen sinks, API, and aluminium bottles. We work with importers, distributors, and project developers across international markets who expect consistency, accountability, and clear communication in every transaction.

Role Overview

We're looking for an **Export Sales Executive** to manage international buyer relationships across one or more of Handmada's product categories or regions. You'll own the full sales cycle — from qualifying an inbound inquiry to closing the order, coordinating with QC and production, and following through to shipment.

This is a hands\-on, buyer\-facing role. You'll be on calls with importers in the US, Europe, GCC, and beyond, negotiating terms, solving problems, and building the kind of trust that turns a one\-time order into a repeat account. You'll report to the Export Sales Manager and work closely with the documentation, QC, and production teams.

Key ResponsibilitiesSales \& Client Management

* Respond to inbound inquiries from international buyers promptly and professionally, understanding their requirements before quoting
* Prepare and send accurate quotations, proforma invoices, and product specifications based on buyer needs
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery timelines within approved margin and policy guidelines
* Follow up consistently on open quotations and pending decisions without being pushy — know when to push and when to give space
* Own the full order lifecycle: confirmation, coordination with production/QC, documentation handoff, and shipment tracking
* Proactively update buyers on order status, delays, or changes — never let a client find out about a problem on their own
* Build long\-term relationships with existing accounts to encourage repeat orders and referrals

Coordination \& Execution

* Liaise with the QC team to confirm buyer specifications are understood and met before dispatch
* Coordinate with the documentation team to ensure invoices, packing lists, and certificates are accurate and on time
* Flag any recurring buyer complaints or spec mismatches to the Export Sales Manager for resolution
* Maintain accurate and updated records of all leads, quotations, and orders in the CRM

Market \& Product Knowledge

* Develop strong working knowledge of assigned product categories — specifications, pricing logic, lead times, and common buyer objections
* Stay updated on market pricing trends, competitor activity, and shifts in buyer demand within assigned regions
* Represent Handmada at trade shows, buyer meetings, or virtual demos as required

Team Contribution

* Share market feedback and buyer insights with the Export Sales Manager to help refine pricing and positioning
* Support the onboarding of new Export Sales Interns by sharing product knowledge and answering questions when asked
* Contribute to a team culture of accountability, responsiveness, and follow\-through

Required Qualifications

* 1\-3 years of experience in international sales, export sales, or B2B sales (freshers with strong communication skills and a relevant degree may also be considered for a junior track)
* Bachelor's degree in Business, International Trade, Marketing, or a related field
* Working knowledge of export basics — incoterms, LC processes, and shipping documentation is a strong plus, but can be trained
* Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages (Spanish, Arabic, French) are an advantage
* Comfortable using CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets, and email/WhatsApp for professional client communication

Key Skills

* **Clear, confident communication** — able to explain specs, pricing, and terms to buyers from different cultures and time zones without confusion
* **Negotiation instinct** — knows when to hold firm on price and when flexibility earns a long\-term client
* **Ownership mindset** — treats every order as their responsibility from inquiry to delivery, not just "my part of it"
* **Organized follow\-through** — nothing falls through the cracks; quotations, follow\-ups, and documentation stay on track
* **Problem\-solving under pressure** — when something goes wrong (a delay, a spec issue), stays calm and finds a solution instead of passing blame
* **Curiosity about the product** — genuinely learns the categories they sell instead of reading off a spec sheet

What We're Looking For (Beyond the Resume)

We want someone who treats every buyer conversation like it matters — not someone chasing a quick close and moving on. You should be the kind of person who:

* Follows up because you actually want the deal to work for both sides, not just to hit a number
* Double\-checks a quotation before sending it, because a wrong number damages trust
* Can tell a buyer "that's not something we do well" instead of overselling
* Wants to understand what you're selling well enough to answer hard questions confidently

Compensation \& Benefits

* Competitive fixed salary \+ performance\-based incentive on closed orders
* Direct exposure to international buyers, trade shows, and cross\-border negotiation
* Clear growth path toward Senior Export Sales Executive or Export Sales Manager roles as you build a track record
* On\-the\-job training in export documentation, pricing, and multi\-category product knowledge

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their resume along with a short note on their sales experience to **husain@handmada.in**, or reach out directly at **\+91 94294 84412**.

Pay: ₹8,192\.77 \- ₹21,673\.75 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Voice Diarization Engineer (Top Pay) — Startup Rebuilding the AI Notetaker Around Rules of Privilege
description:
**Voice Diarization Engineer (Top Pay) —** 
 Startup Rebuilding the AI Notetaker Around Rules of Privilege
 



 AI meetings that know what not to record. The technology is being built — by you.
 



  





**Location** 
 : Bengaluru, India (In Person only) Experience: Open to all levels — from exceptional new graduates to senior speech engineers. We hire for raw ability and slope, not years.
 



  





**What we're building** 




  





 What we're building An AI notetaker for the enterprise that captures every meeting like the tools you already know, then records
 *only what you've agreed to* 
 . A policy you write in plain words decides, in real time as people speak, what gets transcribed and what gets sealed. Privileged conversations, deal terms, customer data, and off\-hand admissions never reach the record. It can pull in counsel the moment a matter turns legal, surface context from past meetings, and keep a full audit trail of every decision, all running inside your own environment across Zoom, Meet, Teams, phone, and email.
 



  





 How it's different Every notetaker today (Otter, Granola, Fireflies, Copilot) makes the same bet: record the whole conversation, then produce a transcript. They only compete on
 *where the audio goes* 
 . None of them decide
 *what should be written down in the first place* 
 . We do. We're the only one that governs capture in the moment: privilege\-aware, running in your own tenant, with every decision logged.
 



  





 Why it matters For law firms, finance, healthcare, and government, anyone who handles privilege, deals, or regulated data, an ungoverned transcript is a liability. Every word is discoverable, leakable, and a compliance risk, and
 *one stray line can sink a case* 
 . These teams want AI notetaking, but they cannot accept indiscriminate capture. That is a large, urgent, underserved market, and we have a patent\-pending wedge into it.
 



  





 Who we're looking for You have lived this problem. You have worked on transcription or speech systems at a company like Google, Otter, or Granola, or you have built a comparable voice\-transcription product yourself, and you are
 *genuinely passionate* 
 about voice, meetings, and getting transcription right.
 



  





**The team is already building** 




  





 Our founding ML engineer was early hire \#10 at Otter.ai, where he spent eight years building the company's core AI from 0 to 1 — speaker diarization and recognition, streaming pipelines, and the LLM fine\-tuning and evaluation frameworks that took AI transcription from demo to daily habit for millions. He holds multiple issued U.S. patents in real\-time transcription, and he leads our engineering team today.
 



  





 The technology has its builder. What the company needs is additional engineering talent to realize its potential — the person who owns what gets built, who it's for, and how it gets sold.
 



  





**Track 1 — Speech \& ML** 




  





 The real\-time active\-inference engine: concurrently with transcription, over a rolling window of speech, classify each moment against natural\-language policy — detecting contemplated deals, named projects, contractual and litigation exposure — and choose an action before the words are committed.
 



 Streaming speech\-to\-text, decoding, VAD, and speaker diarization — learning directly from the engineer who built Otter's diarization from scratch.
 



 Per\-speaker consent enforced by voiceprint: speaker models and acoustic signatures that selectively transcribe only consenting participants, in real time.
 



 Model fine\-tuning and distillation for line\-rate policy classification; evaluation frameworks measuring false\-seal and false\-capture rates, diarization error, and latency budgets. Governance accuracy is the product.
 



  





**Track 2 — Real\-Time Audio \& Systems** 




  





 The real\-time audio spine: low\-latency streaming across Zoom, Meet, Teams, phone/SIP, and desktop audio — WebRTC, WebSockets, meeting\-platform bots and SDKs, jitter and latency engineering.
 



 A provably\-ephemeral memory architecture: audio lives in a volatile store only transiently; nothing reaches durable storage unless policy permits; when a moment is dropped, no copy is retained — provable absence, not a sealed record. If "we never wrote it down" can't be proven, the product doesn't work. This is the deepest systems problem here and the credibility anchor for regulated buyers.
 



 Encryption, key/secret lifecycle, retention and deletion guarantees, immutable audit logging, and deployment inside customer environments.
 



  





**Track 3 — Product \& Agent Engineering** 




  





 The natural\-language policy layer: an admin interface where compliance teams write governance rules in plain English, compiled into something the inference engine evaluates against live speech inside a tight latency budget, applied org\-wide.
 



 The action set the inference drives: transcribe and commit; drop; redact a single value; withhold as privileged; alert a reviewer; invite counsel from a directory; or surface a relevant document, regulation, or prior transcript via retrieval — sometimes through a rate\-limited in\-meeting agent that helps without taking over the room.
 



 Live meeting UX: real\-time transcript views, sealed\-moment indicators, and audit\-trail and compliance views for CFOs, GCs, and security teams. TypeScript/React front end, Python/Node services, real\-time state throughout.
 



  





**Who we're looking for** 




  





 Ideally, you have lived this problem: you've worked on transcription or speech systems at a company like Google, Otter, or Granola — or Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Fireflies, Rev, or a Whisper\-based product — or you've built a comparable voice product yourself, and you're genuinely passionate about voice, meetings, and getting transcription right. You want to own a product end to end, not be one engineer of fifty.
 



  





**But no prior industry experience is required.** 
 We would rather hire the best new graduate in India — and pay top of market for them — than an average engineer with five years of experience. Signals we care about:
 



  





**Exceptional CS fundamentals.** 
 Data structures, algorithms, systems. Top of your class at a top program (IIT, BITS, NIT, IIIT, or equivalent — or you outperformed that bar from anywhere).
 



 Evidence you build. A GitHub with real projects, open\-source contributions, something you shipped, research you published, or competitive results (ICPC, Codeforces, Kaggle). This is our strongest signal.
 



  





 Depth in at least one relevant area: ML/deep learning (PyTorch, Transformers), speech/audio, distributed systems, real\-time networking, or full\-stack product engineering.
 



 Python and one of C\+\+/Java/TypeScript. Clean, fast code; you profile before you guess.
 



 Curiosity about speech and language AI. You've trained a model, read the Whisper paper, or built something with an LLM because you couldn't help yourself.
 



 Founder energy. You move fast, own outcomes, and want to be an early engineer on something that matters.
 



  





**In\-person, in Bengaluru.** 
 This team works together in one room. That's how 0\-to\-1 gets built.
 



  





 Bonus points: on\-device/edge inference, model fine\-tuning, meeting\-platform bots and SDKs, LLM systems, privacy\- and security\-sensitive systems, or prior early/founding engineer experience.
 



  





**How we work — and what AI\-native means here** 




  





**AI\-native:** 
 you ship faster with AI than most teams do without it — because you can tell good output from plausible\-looking output, and you don't merge what you can't stand behind. You own the judgment; AI is your leverage. The bar is your taste, not the model's.

description:
Position: Quality Control (QC) Executive – Plate Washing (Night Shift)Facility

Department

Operations / Quality Assurance

Reporting To

Operations Manager / Facility Manager

Job Summary

The Quality Control (QC) Executive is responsible for ensuring that all cleaned plates, bowls, glasses, cutlery, serving utensils, crates, and other reusable food\-service items meet the company's quality, hygiene, and customer standards before dispatch. The role involves inspecting products at every stage of the washing, drying, sorting, packing, and dispatch process to ensure zero\-defect deliveries and maximum customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Quality Inspection

Inspect all washed plates, bowls, glasses, cutlery, trays, serving utensils, and containers before packing.

Ensure items are completely free from:

Food residue

Oil and grease

Water marks

Stains

Soap or detergent residue

Odor

Dust or contamination

Reject chipped, cracked, broken, bent, rusted, or damaged items.

Verify that all items meet company quality standards before approval.

2\. Dispatch Verification

Verify customer\-wise packing quantities before dispatch.

Ensure correct plate sizes, cutlery types, serving utensils, and accessories are packed according to the dispatch list.

Cross\-check dispatch against customer orders.

Prevent shortages, excess quantities, or wrong item dispatches.

3\. Process Monitoring

Monitor washing, rinsing, drying, sorting, and packing activities.

Ensure Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are followed at every stage.

Conduct random in\-process quality inspections during production.

Ensure rejected items are not mixed with approved inventory.

4\. Hygiene \& Food Safety

Maintain high hygiene standards in washing, drying, inspection, and packing areas.

Ensure employees follow personal hygiene requirements, including gloves, uniforms, masks, hairnets, and hand\-washing procedures.

Verify proper storage of cleaned utensils to prevent contamination.

Report any hygiene or sanitation violations immediately.

5\. Documentation \& Reporting

Maintain Daily QC Inspection Reports.

Record rejection quantities and rejection reasons.

Prepare Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) reports.

Maintain customer complaint records.

Report recurring quality issues to the Operations Manager.

6\. Continuous Improvement

Identify root causes of quality failures.

Recommend improvements in washing, drying, handling, and packing processes.

Assist in reducing customer complaints and product rejections.

Participate in quality improvement initiatives and internal audits.

Authority

The QC Executive has the authority to:

Stop dispatch of non\-conforming materials.

Reject damaged or improperly cleaned utensils.

Recommend rewash or rework of rejected items.

Escalate repeated quality issues to management.

Request corrective actions from Operations or Washing teams.

Required Skills

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong observation and inspection skills.

Basic knowledge of hygiene, sanitation, and food safety practices.

Ability to identify quality defects quickly.

Good communication and coordination skills.

Basic documentation and reporting skills.

Ability to work in a fast\-paced operational environment.

Problem\-solving and decision\-making ability.

Qualifications

Minimum: 12th Pass.

Graduate or Diploma in Hospitality, Food Technology, Quality, or Operations is preferred.

1–3 years of experience in Quality Control, Hospitality, Housekeeping, Laundry, Food Processing, Catering, Warehousing, or Manufacturing.

Freshers with strong learning ability and discipline may also be considered.

Preferred Qualities

Responsible and disciplined.

Honest and dependable.

Positive attitude.

High level of integrity.

Team player.

Punctual and reliable.

Ability to maintain consistent quality standards.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

100% inspection of all dispatch materials.

Zero dispatch of dirty or damaged items.

Reduction in customer quality complaints.

Reduction in rejected or returned materials.

100% compliance with SOPs and hygiene standards.

Dispatch quantity accuracy above 99\.5%.

Timely reporting of quality issues.

Reduction in rewash and rework percentage.

CAPA closure within defined timelines.

Working Conditions

Work in a plate washing and sanitation facility.

Standing and walking for extended periods.

Exposure to wet work areas and cleaning chemicals.

Rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays, as required.

Mandatory use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

Success in This Role

A successful QC Executive consistently ensures that every customer receives clean, hygienic, damage\-free, and accurately packed utensils while maintaining strict compliance with quality standards and contributing to continuous improvement in operational performance.

* Health insurance

  5–8 years
 



**Joining:** 
  Immediate or short notice period
 


**About Roligt** 

 Most of what India drinks and eats has been optimised for shelf life, margin and marketing—in that order. Nutrition often comes later, if it comes at all.
 



 We think that is backwards.
 



 Roligt is a clean food systems company building honest and accountable supply chains—from the farm to the person consuming the product. Our consumer brand, Cocoworks, is a nutrihydration brand built on the tender coconut.
 



 Our operating philosophy is borrowed from medicine, not marketing:
 



**Primum Non Nocere — First, do no harm.** 




 Our founder is a pediatrician and neonatologist, and the principle carries over intact: before anything else, do not make things worse.
 



 For us, this applies to the entire food system—not only the finished product. Harm can occur quietly across the chain: a farmer being squeezed on price, soil being worked beyond recovery, poor employee practices, unnecessary processing or packaging that outlives everyone who touched it.
 



 Our responsibility is to hold the system together as honestly as human effort allows. It is why our labels are short, our processing is minimal, our supply chain is being designed for accountability, and we say no to several things that could make us money faster.
 


**Where We Are Right Now** 

 Roligt is currently at the pre\-seed stage, but this is not our first time in the market.
 



 Cocoworks previously served tens of thousands of customers across Hyderabad. We deliberately paused D2C operations in 2023—not because customers did not want the products, but because the distribution economics did not work, and we refused to burn capital merely to appear as though we were growing.
 



 We have spent the period since rebuilding the foundations:
 


* Supply chain
* Production facility
* Product and quality systems
* Technology and operational workflows
* Distribution model
* Unit economics



 Cocoworks is preparing for its D2C relaunch alongside the deployment of our Nurture Stations.
 



 The team that will carry the next phase is being built now, and the 
 **People \& Capability Lead** 
  will play a central role in shaping it.
 



 You will not inherit an established HR function.
 



 You will build it while the business goes live around you.
 


**The Role** 

 You will own the people function end to end and report directly to the Founder.
 



 Your first year will focus on building foundations that can support the company as it grows: how we hire, how people learn their roles, how performance is measured, how managers are developed, how culture is maintained, and how the organisation remains compliant and audit\-ready.
 



 This is not a conventional HR administration position.
 



 It is a company\-building role.
 


**What You Will Own** 
**1\. Learning and Capability Development** 

 Learning and Development is at the heart of this role.
 



 We operate across food manufacturing, production, quality, field operations and corporate functions. Some positions require formal qualifications and licences; others require strong practical training and consistent adherence to food safety and operational protocols.
 



 Capability\-building is therefore not a nice\-to\-have. It is part of how we keep our promise to the people consuming what we make.
 



 You will:
 


* Design onboarding and induction programmes that make employees genuinely competent—not merely inducted
* Build role\-wise capability frameworks across plant, central kitchen, field and corporate teams
* Identify skill and knowledge gaps across departments
* Establish the learning stack using Zoho Learn and Zoho People
* Track training completion, assessments and practical competency
* Develop refresher\-training and recertification systems
* Engage external trainers where expertise is unavailable internally
* Measure whether training has improved actual workplace performance


**2\. Hiring** 

 You will manage recruitment end to end for a small number of high\-consequence roles.
 



 You will:
 


* Translate business requirements into clear role definitions and scorecards
* Build sourcing channels for specialised and operational roles
* Strengthen Roligt’s employer proposition and recruitment communication
* Screen candidates for competence, ownership and cultural alignment
* Coordinate interviews, assessments, references and offers
* Build a hiring process that is structured, evidence\-based and documented
* Ensure that recruitment decisions are based on capability rather than convenience



 We cannot outspend larger organisations for talent. We will need to out\-think and out\-execute them.
 


**3\. Performance and Growth** 

 You will build a performance system that is honest, lightweight and consistently used.
 



 You will:
 


* Establish clear role outcomes, responsibilities and performance measures
* Create structured probation and confirmation reviews
* Introduce regular manager–employee check\-ins
* Build quarterly and annual performance\-review processes
* Connect performance discussions with learning and development plans
* Coach first\-time managers on delegation, feedback and accountability
* Identify high\-potential employees and capability risks
* Develop career pathways that give good people a reason to stay through the company\-building years


**4\. Culture and Engagement** 

 Roligt will operate across a factory, central kitchen, field locations and office functions.
 



 Your responsibility will be to help a small, distributed team operate as one company.
 



 You will:
 


* Translate Roligt’s principles into observable workplace behaviours
* Build structured employee\-feedback loops
* Ensure that feedback leads to visible action where appropriate
* Establish communication rhythms across departments and locations
* Design recognition and engagement practices suited to a young company
* Strengthen manager accountability for team culture
* Address employee concerns consistently and fairly
* Help create a culture that values evidence, ownership, learning and respectful disagreement


**5\. HR Operations and Compliance** 

 You will build the operational backbone of the people function using real systems—not scattered spreadsheets.
 



 You will own:
 


* HR policies and standard operating procedures
* Employee documentation and personnel records
* Joining, onboarding, confirmation, transfer and exit processes
* Attendance, leave and payroll\-input validation
* Zoho People implementation and employee lifecycle workflows
* EPFO, ESI and applicable statutory compliance
* Labour\-law requirements
* Contract, factory and operational workforce documentation
* Employee letters, contracts and records
* Compliance calendars, audits and evidence trails
* Coordination with payroll, finance, legal and external consultants



 The expectation is simple: clean inputs, clean records and clean audits.
 


**What We Are Looking For** 
* 5–8 years of experience across Human Resources
* Meaningful depth in Learning and Development—this is non\-negotiable
* Experience in an organisation with fewer than 100 employees, where you built systems rather than only administered established processes
* Experience in FMCG, food and beverage, retail, manufacturing or factory\-led businesses is a strong advantage
* Comfort working with factory and operational employees—not only corporate teams
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and startup compliance
* Hands\-on experience with an HRMS; Zoho People is preferred, while Darwinbox, Keka or GreytHR experience is also relevant
* Ability to work with ambiguity and convert incomplete information into a practical plan
* Strong written communication, documentation and stakeholder\-management skills
* MBA or PGDM in Human Resources is preferred but not mandatory where the track record is strong
* Availability to join immediately or within a short notice period


**Who This Role Is Not For** 

 This role may not be suitable for:
 


* Someone looking for an established HR function to administer
* Someone who requires a large budget or a large team before beginning meaningful work
* Someone uncomfortable spending time at a factory or operational location
* Someone who prefers a steady\-state environment over an active company\-building phase
* Someone who treats Learning and Development as an occasional engagement activity
* Someone who avoids difficult performance or accountability conversations
* Someone who is comfortable maintaining systems that are not actually being used


**What You Get** 
* Direct access to the founders
* Genuine influence over how the organisation is built
* Ownership of an entire function from the ground up
* The opportunity to build systems before scale makes poor practices difficult to correct
* Exposure across manufacturing, food systems, technology, consumer products and field operations
* A brand and company with a clear point of view
* The satisfaction of helping build an honest and accountable food systems organisation


**How to Apply** 

 Write to 
 **hr@roligtfoods.com** 




 Along with your CV, tell us about:
 



**One people, learning or HR system you built from nothing while the business was already in motion—and what broke first.**

title: Total Rewards Specialist
description:
**Total Rewards Leader \- Asia**
 Visteon is a global automotive technology leader, advancing mobility through innovative technology solutions that enable a software\-defined future. The company's state\-of\-the\-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI\-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions. With expertise spanning passenger vehicles, commercial transportation, and two\-wheelers, Visteon partners with global automakers to create safer, cleaner, and more connected journeys. Founded in 2000, the company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. In 2024, Visteon recorded annual sales of approximately $3\.87 billion and secured $6\.1 billion in new business. To know more about us, visit visteon.com .
   

  

**Mission of the Role** 
 : Own and elevate the Asia Total Rewards approach to strengthen talent competitiveness, support business growth, and ensure cost‑effective, market‑aligned reward outcomes. Govern compensation, benefits and incentive programs that attract, retain and engage key talent while upholding compliance and financial stewardship.
   

  

**Key Objectives of this Role:**
* Regional Total Rewards Approach \& Governance
* Define and govern the Asia compensation and benefits approach aligned to business priorities, market competitiveness and cost efficiency.
* Lead regional salary structure design, annual compensation cycles and equity reviews with data‑driven insights that reduce risk and strengthen talent outcomes.
* Ensure policy governance, pay‑equity decision frameworks and audit‑ready documentation across all markets.
* Incentive Program Architecture \& Effectiveness (Global)
* Design, optimize and govern short‑term and long‑term incentive programs that align payouts to business performance and talent plan.
* Partner with Finance and HR business partners to model financial implications, establish payout curves, and ensure global consistency and compliance.
* Monitor incentive program ROI, adoption and payout‑to‑performance alignment; recommend improvements based on market trends and internal analytics.
* Benefits Portfolio Optimization
* Govern regional benefits design, cost‑of‑care trends and employee insights.
* Deliver improved financial and service outcomes through annual vendor negotiations and experience‑based redesigns.
* Benchmark programs against regional practices to maintain competitiveness and cost effectiveness.
* Stakeholder Enablement \& Communication
* Build and deliver Asia‑wide Total Rewards communication materials and leader‑enablement training to drive consistent understanding and adoption.
* Provide leaders with transparent frameworks, market insights and decision tools that strengthen reward governance and reduce exceptions.
* Partner with talent and business excellence teams to integrate Total Rewards insights into workforce planning and talent plan.


**Key Performance Indicators:**
* Achieve ≥80% alignment between incentive payouts and business performance metrics across all major plans.
* Reduce pay‑structure exceptions and off‑cycle adjustments by ≥20% through governance and leader enablement.


**Key Year One Deliverables:**
* Deliver a cohesive global incentive architecture aligned to business and talent plan.
* A clear and actionable Asia Total Rewards approach


**Qualification, Experience and Skills:**
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced HR certification preferred.
* 8\+ years of progressive compensation and benefits experience in a multinational environment.
* Demonstrated expertise in designing, implementing and governing incentive programs.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to model program and cost impacts.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross‑functional decision‑making.
* Excellent project management, stakeholder communication and analytical skills.


**Key Leadership Behaviors:**
* Lead from the Front
* Lead the Market
* Critical Thinking


**Reporting Structure:** 
 This role will report to Global Head of Total Rewards
   

  

**In the fast lane of technology.** 
 At Visteon, we’re redefining how the world connects through its vehicles. Our innovations transform the driving experience for millions, powered by a high\-performance culture that challenges the status quo and sparks new possibilities—in careers and communities. Join us and help shape the future.

**Position Title**

**Company**

**About Us**
 PayU Finance stands as the premier credit and lending division of the PayU brand, a wholly\-owned subsidiary of the globally renowned Prosus group (formerly Naspers group) headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands. With an impressive track record of disbursing over $280 million in consumer credit and approximately 20 billion loans by volume, we have established ourselves as a market leader in financial technology innovation. PayU Finance provides consumers and merchants with easy access to affordable short\-term/medium\-term loans.
   

  

**About Role**
 This pivotal position sits at the intersection of innovation and expansion within our embedded merchant lending division at PayU Finance. As a key contributor, you will be instrumental in our "0 to 1" scaling journey, where your expertise will drive the transformation of how we leverage both alternative and traditional data sources to extend credit to underserved/new market segments. Your impact will be realized through the strategic application of advanced analytics, cutting\-edge data science methodologies, and deep domain knowledge.
   

  

**Role Details**
* Develop and implement credit risk management strategies ensuring lending activities are prudent, profitable, and compliant with regulations
* Design credit policies using traditional and alternative data sources to optimize risk\-adjusted returns while meeting business objectives
* Partner with senior leadership and partners to establish scalable risk frameworks that support our hyper\-growth trajectory
* Establish and refine acquisition and customer management strategies specifically tailored for our merchant lending business
* Collaborate across Business, Data Science, Product, and Technology teams to create customer\-centric solutions that enable prudent scaling
* Work directly with C\-suite executives to ensure appropriate risk strategies are implemented throughout the organization
* Champion a culture of proactive risk management that supports our mission


**Candidate Profile**
**Educational Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
   

  

**Experience**
* 1\-2 years of Experience in Credit Risk Policy / Risk Analytics OR
* 1\-2 years of Experience in Business Analytics/Business Strategy


**Skills Required**
* Strong problem\-solving abilities with strong communication and stakeholder management skills to successfully deliver business and risk initiatives
* Proficiency in at least one technical language (R, SAS, Python, or SQL)
* Demonstrated ability to visualize complex data analyses and communicate insights effectively to diverse audiences, including executive leadership
* Strong sense of ownership with proven track record of delivering results\-focused projects

title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
• Data Ingestion and Integration: Ingest data from various sources such as databases, files, APIs, and streaming platforms into Azure. For example, you could use Azure Data Factory to orchestrate the extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data from an on\-premises SQL Server database to Azure Blob Storage. • Data Transformation and Processing: Perform data transformation and processing tasks to prepare the data for analysis and reporting. Azure Databricks or Azure Synapse Analytics can be used for large\-scale data transformations using tools like Apache Spark. • Data Storage and Management: Select and manage the appropriate storage solutions for your data. For instance, you could use Azure SQL Database or Azure Cosmos DB for structured data, Azure Data Lake Storage for big data and unstructured data, or Azure Blob Storage for file storage. • Data Warehousing: Implementing data warehousing solutions is a common use case for Azure Data Engineers. Azure Synapse Analytics (formerly Azure SQL Data Warehouse) offers scalable and distributed analytics capabilities for handling large datasets. • Data Modeling and Analysis: Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to design and implement data models for analytical workloads. Azure Analysis Services or Azure Databricks can be used for building and deploying models to support interactive data analysis.
 



 Good\-to\-Have • DevOps and Automation: Automating data pipelines, monitoring data processes, and managing deployments are important tasks for Azure Data Engineers. They may use tools like Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, and Azure Automation to achieve continuous integration and delivery.

Originally established to engineer next\-generation micro\-materials, BNT has rapidly expanded into designing proprietary AI\-powered middleware, advanced RAG frameworks, and highly complex automation engines that service global software corporations.
   

  

 Our focus remains on building reliable, cloud\-native backend infrastructure that scales to handle millions of real\-time queries. At Best NanoTech, engineers are encouraged to break traditional structural paradigms, write modular backend components, and deploy cutting\-edge language models (LLMs) to automate end\-to\-end organizational workflows. We foster an inclusive, fast\-paced culture where individual ownership is celebrated, and professional technical curiosity is heavily rewarded.

 📈 Industry Insights \& Career Growth
   

  

 The tech ecosystem is undergoing a dramatic shift from traditional SaaS application development to AI\-driven, agentic software engineering. Developers who possess hands\-on familiarity with the
 **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** 
 , prompt orchestration frameworks, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) are in incredibly high demand globally. By joining Best NanoTech's AI Platform team early in your career, you position yourself as a highly\-skilled modern backend specialist capable of handling stateful LLM operations.
   

  

**Career Pathway:** 
 Selected candidates will undergo a fast\-track training program covering cloud\-native deployment with Azure, microservices management using Docker, and automated CI/CD pipeline building on GitHub. Freshers can expect to transition from Associate Engineers to Senior AI Platform Architects within 18 to 24 months, based on their individual project contributions and ability to build robust production workflows.

* Academic Degrees: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, MCA, or related mathematical disciplines (2024, 2025, and 2026 batches welcome).
* Experience Range: 0 to 2 Years. Strong programming fundamentals are preferred over tenure. Freshers with powerful academic projects are highly valued.

* Minimum GPA/Percentage: 60% or 6\.0 CGPA throughout 10th, 12th, and Graduation without any active backlogs.


 📝 Responsibilities \& Key Deliverables
   

  

 In this specialized engineering capacity, you will directly configure, maintain, and expand our AI platform:
   

  

* Backend Engineering: Design, optimize, and launch reliable RESTful and gRPC APIs using Node.js and Python.
* AI \& LLM Services Integration: Connect proprietary business operations to LLM backends (Azure OpenAI, Claude) using advanced prompt engineering and prompt orchestrations.
* Vector Database Architecture: Construct, feed, and manage specialized Vector Databases to process embedded semantic datasets utilizing modern RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) models.
* DevOps \& Deployment: Build robust containers using Docker and manage deployments across secure cloud systems like MS Azure.
* Collaborative Development: Engage in code standard maintenance, Git reviews, merge conflicts resolution, and document architecture processes in Markdown.


 🧠 Desired Technical Skills Matrix
   

  

 Applicants are evaluated on their fundamental alignment with the following modern software tools:
   

  

**Programming Languages \& Core Frameworks**
 Node.js Python 3\.x Linux Terminal Shell Scripting
   

  

**AI Platform \& Prompt Orchestration**
 Azure OpenAI APIs Claude (Anthropic) Model Context Protocol (MCP) RAG Architectures Vector Search
   

  

**Databases \& DevOps Systems**
 PostgreSQL MySQL Vector Databases Docker CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
   

  

 🎯 Recruitment \& Interview Roadmap
   

  

 Best NanoTech employs a streamlined three\-tiered hiring framework designed to quickly filter top programming talent:
   

  

 Round 1: Initial Cognitive \& Programming Screening
   

  

 A remote objective test focused on fundamental data structures (Arrays, Trees, Hashing), API design architecture, database schema management, and basic programming implementations in Node.js or Python.
   

  

 Round 2: Architectural Deep\-Dive \& System Design
   

  

 A detailed session with the Principal AI Architect exploring real\-life production concepts: constructing RAG loops, troubleshooting API latency, handling vector query throughput, and maintaining secure Docker pipelines.
   

  

 Round 3: Technical\-Managerial Alignment Round
   

  

 A final evaluation with Senior Leadership (featuring Tech Director Sanjeev Dhawan) to measure collaborative performance, passion for AI engineering, operational alignment, and salary execution planning.

* Core LLM Orchestration: Understand the differences between calling API inference models directly and leveraging a prompt orchestration structure (such as LangChain or custom event wrappers).
* Data Sync Pipeline: Explain the operational flow of pulling raw unstructured content, parsing it to semantic vectors with Embeddings models, and validating similarity metrics in Vector databases.
* Dockerizing Node.js/Python microservices: Study container setup patterns, minimizing container build sizes, and utilizing continuous integration triggers dynamically.
