**Meet the Team**
 The DSE Platform Independent Common (PI\-Common) group develops high\-performance, platform\-independent system software that runs across Cisco’s flagship routers and switches. We design and deliver core routing protocols and infrastructure components that power Cisco’s Mass Scale Infrastructure, Cloud Networking, and Network Experience portfolios.
   

  

 Our team works on key control\-plane technologies including IGP routing protocols such as OSPF, IS\-IS, EIGRP and RIP, BGP\-LS, First Hop Redundancy Protocols such as HSRP, VRRP and GLBP, and routing infrastructure components such as route\-policy frameworks, prefix handling, filtering, and control\-plane scalability mechanisms.
   

  

 These components form the foundation of networking deployments across enterprise, service provider, cloud, and AI infrastructure environments, where scale, resiliency, security, programmability, and operational debuggability are critical.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Software Engineer in PI\-Common, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of routing protocol and routing infrastructure software used across Cisco platforms. You will work with senior engineers to build reliable, scalable, and debuggable control\-plane software. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

 Developing features, enhancements, and defect fixes for IGP protocols, BGP\-LS, FHRP technologies, and routing infrastructure components.
   

  

 Writing clean, efficient, maintainable code in C/C\+\+ for multi\-threaded, system\-level software environments.
   

  

 Contributing to routing infrastructure components such as route\-policy handling, filtering, prefix processing, and control\-plane integration modules.
   

  

 Debugging software issues using logs, traces, core files, protocol state, and platform\-level diagnostics.
   

  

 Participating in root cause analysis for defects and customer\-found issues, with guidance from senior engineers.
   

  

 Building unit, functional, regression, and scale validation coverage for protocol and infrastructure changes.
   

  

 Working closely with platform, hardware, and test teams to validate software behavior across Cisco operating systems and platforms.
   

  

 Learning protocol behavior, implementation details, and operational aspects of production routing systems.
   

  

 Participating in design discussions, code reviews, and technical reviews to build strong engineering judgment.
   

  

 Contributing to team quality, automation, debuggability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications Required**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Networking, or a related technical field.
* 1\-3 years of relevant software development experience.
* Strong understanding of data structures, operating systems, and computer networking fundamentals.
* Programming experience in C or C\+\+.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or Perl.
* Familiarity with Unix/Linux development environments.
* Good problem\-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.


**Preferred Qualifications Good To Have**
 Exposure to routing protocols such as OSPF, IS\-IS, EIGRP, RIP, BGP, or BGP\-LS.
   

  

 Understanding of multi\-threaded programming, IPC, memory management, or system\-level software concepts.
   

  

 Familiarity with debugging tools such as gdb, logs, packet captures, traces, or core\-file analysis.
   

  

 Exposure to networking software, embedded systems, distributed systems, or large\-scale infrastructure software.

title: Avua Remote Junior Software Developer Job 2026
description:
Junior Software Developer at Avua
   

  

 📍 Remote (PAN India) 💰 ₹6\+ LPA (Est. Glassdoor Range) 🎓 B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / M.Tech / MCA
   

  

 📅 Posted Date:
 **July 5, 2026** 
 ⏳ Apply Before:
 **ASAP**
 🏢 About Avua \& HR\-Tech Innovation
   

  

 Avua is a pioneering technology enterprise specializing in SaaS\-based recruiting solutions, artificial intelligence integrations, and predictive hiring pipelines. Incorporated as a premium talent acquisition innovator, Avua utilizes deep neural networks, natural language processing (NLP), and cloud\-native assessment environments to simplify recruitment pathways worldwide. Its primary platform transforms historical resume filtering by establishing semantic context matching, replacing traditional keyword searches with intent\-driven talent discovery.
   

  

 Operating on a global remote framework, Avua serves fast\-scaling enterprises and Fortune 500 corporations in the US, Europe, and India. The platform is continuously refined by a high\-caliber distributed engineering team that deploys real\-time analytics engines, career visualization algorithms, automated salary benchmarking interfaces, and interactive ATS integration middleware. Joining Avua means becoming a part of a specialized, high\-growth environment dedicated to reshaping the global future of work.
   

  

 ⭐ 4\.2/5 on Glassdoor 👨‍💻 100\-500 Global Talents 🚀 Leading AI\-Driven Recruiter
   

  

 📝 Official Designation
   

  

 Junior Software Developer
   

  

 💰 Estimated Compensation
   

  

 ₹6\+ LPA (Est. Base Range)
   

  

 🕒 Location \& Program
   

  

 Remote (Work From Home) \| Full\-time
   

  

 🌟 Role Significance \& Engineering Growth
   

  

 Stepping into Avua as a Junior Software Developer is distinct from conventional services\-oriented training roles. In classical enterprise frameworks, junior coders are often isolated to repetitive maintenance or test case scripting. At Avua, you enter a collaborative, product\-first SaaS environment where you work directly on production\-level platforms. Under the guidance of seasoned principal engineers, you will contribute directly to microservices development, performance profiling, and web app modules used daily by recruiters and global candidates.
   

  

 Our engineering team operates on a highly decentralized, remote\-first setup. This structure requires and builds strong operational discipline, proactive asynchronous communication skills, and complete ownership of assigned Git branches. Junior engineers are supported through 1:1 mentorship loops, collaborative pair programming, and modular system reviews. This systematic foundation accelerates your progress from writing functional components to architecting complex, scalable software modules.
   

  

 ✅ Eligibility Criteria
   

  

* Educational Background: Currently pursuing or completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative technical field.
* Batch Eligibility: Ideally structured for the 2024, 2025, and 2026 graduating cohorts, including ambitious 2027 graduates seeking immediate technical transitions.
* Foundational Programming: Strong foundational command of at least one general\-purpose programming language, with priority on JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C\+\+, or Java.
* Object\-Oriented Concepts: Thorough understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) architectures, software life cycles, and solid modular design practices.
* Modern Tech Stack Familiarity: Basic exposure to web frameworks like React.js, Angular, Node.js, Spring Boot, or Django is highly advantageous.
* Collaboration \& Git: Solid understanding of code versioning standards, branching strategies, and collaborative code reviews using Git/GitHub.
* Analytic Mindset: Exceptional debugging capabilities, logical problem\-solving skills, and a strong self\-driven workflow suitable for remote environments.


 📝 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* App Development \& Maintenance: Assist in the conceptualization, design, development, unit testing, and maintenance of Avua’s core recruitment\-focused web and mobile interfaces.
* Clean Code Delivery: Write clean, logical, documented, and performance\-optimized code following standard architectural guidelines under the guidance of tech leads.
* Collaborate and Solve: Team up with cross\-functional product departments including QA, UI/UX, and product managers to split complex features into modular, shippable units.
* Troubleshooting \& Performance: Investigate, reproduce, debug, and fix application bottlenecks, runtime issues, and responsiveness concerns in production environments.
* Code Quality Reviews: Participate actively in asynchronous code review processes, accepting constructive feedback to improve your software design skills.
* Modern Tech Adoption: Stay updated with evolving industry trends, containerized platforms, cloud infrastructure metrics, and AI development frameworks.


 💻 Tech Trends \& Software Horizons (2026\-2027\)
   

  

 The technology industry is experiencing a massive wave of consolidation towards cloud\-native distributed scaling and AI\-native automation. In the modern developer ecosystem, building simple web applications is no longer sufficient. Enterprise systems demand high availability, event\-driven integrations (via Kafka, RabbitMQ), and highly optimized REST/GraphQL APIs that can parse millions of documents concurrently. Building microservices that are isolated, containerized via Docker, and orchestrated on AWS or GCP is now standard across product companies.
   

  

 Additionally, the rise of remote\-first engineering structures has highlighted the value of clean, maintainable architecture. Junior developers are evaluated not just on their raw coding speed, but on their ability to write solid test suites, utilize structured logging, analyze runtime metrics, and navigate distributed systems safely. Developing these foundational skills early in your career ensures long\-term professional adaptability.
   

  

 🧠 Recommended Tech Skills Mapping
   

  

 JavaScript / TypeScript Python \& Java Core React.js \& Node.js Data Structures \& OOP SQL (PostgreSQL / MySQL) Git \& GitHub Workflows Cloud \& Docker (Basic)
   

  

 🎯 Avua Technical Selection Pipeline
   

  

* Profile Screening \& Portfolio Audit


 Candidates are initially filtered based on academic backgrounds, personal project repositories (GitHub), and technical portfolio diversity. Highlighting functional full\-stack projects or open\-source commits will accelerate screening times.
   

  

* Online Technical Assessment (OA)


 A timed online challenge featuring logical problem\-solving tasks, fundamental core programming (Java/Python/JS), and standard object\-oriented programming (OOP) logic.
   

  

* Live Technical \& System Concepts Interview


 A live video discussion with Avua's senior engineers covering fundamental algorithm behaviors, database queries, basic API development patterns, and live debugging tasks.
   

  

* Managerial \& Remote Coordination Fit


 An interactive fitment check focusing on your communication skills, project execution steps, and adaptability to distributed collaborative workflows.
   

  

 🚀 Boost Your Placement Preparation
   

  

 📝 Practice Our Placement Test Simulator
   

  

 Get fully synchronized online mock practice tests calibrated directly for top IT firms and product giants. Track real\-time speed, scoring matrices, and improve key problem\-solving areas in realistic testing situations!
   

  

 💼 StudyEcart Premium Java Full\-Stack Developer Program
   

  

 Master complex back\-end architectures, microservices optimization, Spring framework, database systems, and interactive UI frameworks. Join our curated professional cohort designed specifically to land premium technology offers.
   

  

 💡 Avua Tech Interview Key Tips
   

  

**🔥 Core Topics To Master Before Your Call**
* Data Structure Foundations: Array operations, string manipulations, hash maps, and sliding window optimization patterns.
* Relational Logic: Designing normalised schema modules, execution of complex SQL joins, and query optimisation metrics.
* OOP Principles: Master clear definitions and coding examples for Encapsulation, Polymorphism, Inheritance, and Abstraction.


 🧾 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
   

  

 Q: Are graduates of the 2026 batch eligible to apply?
   

  

 A: Yes, this role is fully accessible to graduates and students in the 2024, 2025, and 2026 cohorts. Final\-year students are highly encouraged to submit applications.
   

  

 Q: Is relocation to a physical office required for this role?
   

  

 A: No. The Junior Software Developer role is a full\-time, 100% remote job. You will collaborate with the team from your home location anywhere in India.
   

  

 Q: What is the typical development framework utilized at Avua?
   

  

 A: Avua operates a diversified tech stack. Backend layers are built in Node.js, Python, and Java (Spring Boot), while user interfaces are constructed using React.js/TypeScript alongside containerised cloud tools on AWS.

 Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.
   

  

 Seismic is the global leader in AI\-powered enablement, empowering go\-to\-market leaders to drive strategic growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences at scale. The Seismic Enablement Cloud™ is the only unified AI\-powered platform that prepares customer\-facing teams with the skills, content, tools, and insights needed to maximize every buyer interaction and strengthen client relationships. Trusted by more than 2,000 organizations worldwide, Seismic helps businesses achieve measurable outcomes and accelerate revenue growth. Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. Learn more at seismic.com.
   

  

**Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.**
**Overview:**
**Seismic AI:**
 AI is one of the fastest growing product areas in Seismic. We believe that AI, particularly Generative AI, will empower and transform how Enterprise sales and marketing organizations operate and interact with customers. Seismic Aura, our leading AI engine, is powering this change in the sales enablement space and is being infused across the Seismic enablement cloud. Our focus is to leverage AI across the Seismic platform to make our customers more productive and efficient in their day\-to\-day tasks, and to drive more successful sales outcomes.
   

  

**Who you are:**
**Experience:**
* 1\+ years of experience in software engineering, with experience contributing to frontend or UI\-focused web applications.


**Technical Expertise:**
* Full\-stack experience (C\#, Node.js, Python)
* Experience with HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Experience building user interfaces using React, including functional components, hooks, and state management patterns.
* Experience with TypeScript, including writing strongly typed components and APIs.
* Familiarity with modern CSS techniques such as CSS Modules, styled\-components, Tailwind, or similar approaches.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with REST or GraphQL APIs.
* Working knowledge of automated frontend testing practices (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright).
* Experience using Git for source control and collaborating through pull requests.
* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and modern frontend pipelines, including GitHub Actions.
* Exposure to frontend performance optimization techniques (code splitting, lazy loading, memoization).
* Exposure to accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practices is a plus.
* Exposure to design systems or component libraries is a plus.


**Cloud Expertise:**
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure.
* Basic familiarity with cloud\-native services for data storage, compute, and monitoring.
* Experience deploying or supporting containerized applications in Kubernetes is a plus.


**Good to have: Search/retrieval/AI:**
* Interest or exposure to search or information retrieval systems.
* RAG/generative AI, conversational AI, agents, LLMs.
* Familiarity with search platforms such as Elasticsearch, Apache Solr, or similar is a plus.
* Basic understanding of text processing, semantic search, or AI\-driven features is beneficial.


**SaaS Knowledge:** 
 Experience working on SaaS applications or cloud\-hosted services. Understanding of standard concepts related to modern distributed systems and cloud operations.
   

  

**Product Development:** 
 Experience collaborating with product management and design to implement well\-defined requirements. Ability to translate clear business and technical requirements into working software. Contribute to feature development within a defined scope.
   

  

* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with teams across different regions.
* Willingness to collaborate with the China team and participate in cross\-timezone work as needed.
* Scrum and JIRA experience a plus.


**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

**Fast\-paced Environment:** 
 Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, preferably in a SaaS or technology\-driven company.
   

  

**What you’ll be doing:**
**As a Software Engineer I** 
 for our
 **Agentic AI Interfaces** 
 team, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of backend systems that power our web application, including search, content discovery, and AI capabilities. You will work closely with senior engineers and cross\-functional partners to build reliable, scalable systems that deliver value to our customers while continuing to grow your technical expertise.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Distributed Systems Development: Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of backend systems and services supporting search functionality, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Search \& Algorithm Support: Assist in implementing search and/or AI\-related features, including indexing, retrieval, and ranking logic, to improve search accuracy and efficiency.
* Integration: Collaborate with engineers, AI partners, and product teams to integrate search and AI\-driven capabilities across the Seismic platform.
* Performance Tuning: Participate in monitoring and performance tuning efforts, identifying routine bottlenecks and applying guided improvements to ensure acceptable query latency.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams, including product managers, frontend engineers, and UX designers, to support seamless search experiences.
* Continuous Improvement: Learn and apply new tools, technologies, and best practices related to search, backend development, and AI systems.


**What we have for you:**
 At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
   

  

 Headquartered in San Diego and with employees across the globe, Seismic is the global leader in sales
 **enablement** 
 , backed by firms such as Permira, Ameriprise Financial, EDBI, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and T. Rowe Price. Seismic also expanded its team and product portfolio with the strategic acquisitions of SAVO, Percolate, Grapevine6, and Lessonly. Our board of directors is composed of several industry luminaries including John Thompson, former Chairman of the Board for Microsoft.
   

  

 Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.

 Ecolab is a global sustainability titan trusted by millions across more than 170 countries. As the undisputed world leader in water management, hygiene services, and infection prevention solutions, Ecolab helps secure clean water, safe food, and abundant energy. Beyond physical operations, Ecolab leverages cutting\-edge technology as a critical business driver. Its specialized engineering teams build next\-generation cloud architectures, real\-time IoT diagnostic pipelines, predictive asset management models, and heavy data systems that monitor thousands of industrial operations worldwide.
   

  

 The Ecolab Digital Center (EDC) in Bengaluru, India, serves as the primary strategic global technology accelerator driving software innovation across the parent company's commercialized portfolio. At the EDC, engineering teams scale robust SaaS platforms that capture sensor data from heavy machinery, optimize sanitization schedules for hospitals, and run advanced machine\-learning simulations to minimize energy consumption. Operating in a progressive, collaborative workplace culture, the center supports continuous learning and offers engineers a direct pathway to design complex enterprise products that positively impact global human health and environmental preservation.

 Associate Software Engineer

 Bengaluru \| Hybrid Office
   

  

 🌟 Entry\-Level Impact \& Engineering Learning Curve
   

  

 Joining Ecolab as an Associate Software Engineer is an immersive learning experience designed for high\-potential engineering graduates. In traditional corporate software setups, early\-career engineers are often assigned isolated, non\-critical sub\-tasks or general manual data entry. At Ecolab, you enter as a fully functional contributor, integrated directly into product development teams. Under the guidance of experienced tech leads and principal architects, you will participate in designing clean, scalable code modules that meet international regulatory and safety standards.
   

  

 The primary objective of this role is to establish your fundamental technical framework, converting theoretical CS knowledge into production\-ready software systems. Associate engineers are supported by structured 1:1 mentoring pathways, learning sessions with architects in higher grades, and complete exposure to robust Agile development cycles. Over time, you will learn to navigate complex microservice designs, clean testing methods, and automated CI/CD deployments, rapidly preparing you to take complete ownership of critical system structures.
   

  

 ✅ Eligibility Criteria
   

  

* Educational Background: Currently pursuing or completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a quantitative mathematical field of study.
* Batch Eligibility: Specifically structured for the 2024, 2025, and 2026 graduating cohorts. Ambitious 2027 graduates available for immediate full\-time transitions are welcome.
* Professional Experience: 0 to 2 years of active development experience. Alternatively, candidates with 4–6 years of equivalent combined tech\-education and hands\-on project work are fully eligible.
* Languages of Choice: Foundational grasp of at least one general\-purpose programming language, with target priorities on Java, Python, C\#, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Core Foundations: Clear, strong comprehension of basic Data Structures, Algorithms (DSA), and Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) architectures.
* Collaborative Tooling: Basic knowledge of code repositories, version control protocols, and branching structures using Git or GitHub.
* Analytic Mindset: Eagerness to absorb modern engineering patterns, outstanding debugging capabilities, and excellent verbal and written communication skills.


 📝 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Feature Development: Write, modify, document, and test clean application code that directly meets specific commercialized project requirements and system standards.
* Documentation Support: Assist senior developers in drafting comprehensive software design specifications, API structures, and platform architecture flowcharts.
* QA \& Debugging: Collaborate actively with testing and QA engineering departments to reproduce, investigate, and correct software bugs and system bottlenecks.
* Continuous Learning: Participate in structural team meetings and code reviews to learn technical standards and strategies implemented by senior engineers.
* Agile Alignment: Participate in Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and asynchronous communication updates to support clean, on\-time project iterations.
* Security \& Quality Metrics: Write robust, secure code under the supervision of your security manager, helping secure private industrial data modules.


 💻 Industrial IoT \& Sustainability Horizons (2026\-2027\)
   

  

 The convergence of sustainability goals with digital system design is driving a major transformation across industrial tech ecosystems. Modern resource\-management platforms are no longer static databases; they are reactive ecosystems operating on high\-velocity data streaming channels. Millions of connected sensors on factory floors, water purification systems, and hospital ventilation networks send real\-time streams that must be parsed instantly to identify errors, prevent wastage, and avoid hardware failures.
   

  

 As we approach 2027, software engineering is heavily centered on optimizing this "Edge\-to\-Cloud" data path. Junior developers entering this ecosystem are expected to write highly efficient backend logic in Java/Spring Boot or Node.js, run optimized relational database commands, and build secure API architectures. Learning to deploy microservices within isolated container structures like Docker, while optimizing for low memory consumption, ensures that engineers can scale software platforms to meet modern industrial needs.

 🎯 Ecolab Technical Selection Pipeline

 Candidates are initially filtered based on academic background, programming projects, and clear documentation. Highlighting clean OOP concepts or complete full\-stack web projects inside your resume accelerates initial callback rates.
   

  

* Online Technical Assessment (OA)


 A timed platform challenge featuring analytical aptitude tasks, fundamental software logic questions, core coding snippets (Java/Python/C\#), and standard SQL join scenarios.
   

  

* Live Technical \& Database Evaluation


 An interactive live session with Ecolab senior developers focusing on basic database normalization, OOP architecture patterns, debugging steps, and algorithmic complexity checks.
   

  

* Managerial Fitment \& Project Synergy


 A conversation focusing on project team coordination, enthusiasm to learn unfamiliar tech stacks, operational safety guidelines, and cultural fit within Ecolab's decentralized workspace.

description:
**Medicheck Hospital in Haryana**

Medicheck Group of Hospitals is a trusted network dedicated to delivering advanced, ethical, and compassionate healthcare across Haryana. With a strong focus on clinical excellence and patient well\-being, Medicheck combines modern technology with the expertise of experienced medical professionals.

The network includes the Medicheck Institute of Medical Sciences (MIMS), Palwal, offering comprehensive multi\-speciality services; Medicheck Hospital, NIT\-1 Faridabad, known for dependable and family\-focused care; and the Medicheck Ortho Superspeciality Hospital, Sector\-46 Faridabad, providing advanced orthopaedic and joint care. Together, these centres reflect Medicheck's mission to make quality healthcare accessible and patient\-friendly.

**About Us**

Medicheck Institute of Medical Sciences (MIMS Hospital), is a trusted Palwal’s first 300\-bedded multispeciality hospital in Palwal, offering advanced consultations, expert diagnosis, and comprehensive OPD care across multiple super\-specialities.We aim to bring tertiary\-level healthcare expertise closer to the people of Palwal through compassionate, accessible, and advanced medical care.

From joint pain, back pain, asthma, hypertension, and kidney disorders to complex treatments and surgeries for the heart, brain, spine, knee, and more, patients can now access advanced care from some of Delhi NCR’s leading super\-specialist doctors, closer to home.

**Job Description: Operation Theatre (OT) Technician**

**Operation Theatre (OT) Technician**

Department

Operation Theatre (OT)

Qualification

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Operation Theatre Technology (DOTT/B.Sc. Operation Theatre Technology) or an equivalent recognized qualification.
* Certification in Basic Life Support (BLS) is preferred.

Experience

* Minimum 1 year of experience as an OT Technician in a hospital or surgical center.
* Freshers with relevant clinical training or internship may be considered.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare the operation theatre before surgical procedures by ensuring cleanliness, sterility, and readiness of equipment.
* Arrange and sterilize surgical instruments, drapes, consumables, and other equipment required for surgeries.
* Assist surgeons, anesthetists, and nursing staff during surgical procedures.
* Ensure the proper functioning of OT equipment, including operating tables, suction machines, cautery units, monitors, lights, and anesthesia machines, and promptly report any malfunction.
* Maintain aseptic techniques and comply with infection prevention and control protocols.
* Assist in patient positioning, transfer, and preparation before and after surgery.
* Count surgical instruments, needles, and sponges before, during, and after procedures in coordination with the OT nursing staff.
* Clean, disinfect, and prepare the operation theatre for subsequent procedures.
* Maintain records of OT instruments, equipment, sterilization, and inventory.
* Ensure adequate stock of surgical supplies and communicate replenishment requirements to the appropriate department.
* Handle biomedical waste according to hospital policies and statutory guidelines.
* Support emergency and trauma surgeries as required.
* Participate in OT quality improvement initiatives, safety audits, and continuing education programs.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of operation theatre procedures and sterile techniques.
* Familiarity with surgical instruments and OT equipment.
* Understanding of infection prevention and biomedical waste management.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and respond to emergency situations.
* Good communication, teamwork, and organizational skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to patient safety.

* Rotational shifts, including day, evening, night, weekends, and public holidays.

* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.

* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.

* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines

* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.

* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.

* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.

* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.

title: Area General Manager
description:
AREA GENERAL MANAGER (AGM)Business Growth \& Consulting

**ORIGENNT Private Limited**  
**Department:** Business Development \& Consulting  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** As Assigned  
**Reporting To:** Co\-Founder / National Sales Head

ABOUT ORIGENNT

ORIGENNT Private Limited is a growing Management Consulting and Business Enablement Company focused on helping organizations achieve sustainable growth through strategic consulting, operational improvement, and execution\-driven solutions.

ORIGENNT works with businesses and institutions across multiple sectors, including Startups, MSMEs, Healthcare Institutions, Manufacturing Companies, Educational Organizations, Hospitality Businesses, Real Estate Firms, IT Companies, Retail Enterprises, Logistics Providers, NGOs, and Professional Service Organizations.

The Company's integrated service portfolio includes:

* Management Consulting
* Business Strategy \& Growth Consulting
* HR Consulting \& Recruitment
* Branding \& Digital Marketing
* Website \& Mobile Application Development
* SOP Development \& Process Consulting
* Corporate Training
* Business Registration \& Compliance Support
* CRM \& ERP Consulting
* Performance Management Systems
* Business Automation

POSITION OVERVIEW

The **Area General Manager (AGM) – Business Growth \& Consulting** is a strategic leadership position responsible for driving business expansion, revenue growth, client acquisition, market development, and team performance within an assigned territory.

The AGM will serve as a senior representative of ORIGENNT and will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, developing corporate relationships, acquiring clients, presenting consulting solutions, leading sales and growth teams, and contributing directly to the Company's regional and national expansion objectives.

The role requires a commercially driven professional with strong leadership ability, strategic thinking, business development expertise, consulting orientation, and the ability to manage people, performance, processes, and client relationships.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Regional Business Growth

* Develop and execute regional business expansion strategies aligned with ORIGENNT's organizational vision and quarterly objectives.
* Identify new markets, industries, business segments, and growth opportunities.
* Build a strong and sustainable regional business pipeline.
* Contribute to the development of ORIGENNT's market presence and brand reputation.

2\. Business Development \& Client Acquisition

* Identify and qualify prospective corporate, institutional, and business clients also close targets as provided by the company monthly and quarterly.
* Generate leads through direct outreach, networking, referrals, strategic partnerships, events, and other business development channels.
* Conduct business meetings, corporate presentations, discovery meetings, and consulting discussions.
* Understand client challenges and recommend appropriate ORIGENNT solutions.
* Prepare and present business proposals and commercial presentations.
* Lead negotiations and support the conversion of prospects into long\-term clients.

3\. Consulting\-Oriented Sales

* Position ORIGENNT as a strategic business partner rather than merely a service provider.
* Diagnose business challenges and identify opportunities for consulting intervention.
* Develop solution\-oriented proposals based on client requirements.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-selling and upselling ORIGENNT's integrated services.
* Maintain a high standard of professional and ethical business conduct.

4\. Team Leadership \& Performance Management

* Lead, guide, mentor, and monitor Sales \& Growth Consultants within the assigned area.
* Set performance expectations and monitor individual and team productivity.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly sales activities.
* Monitor lead generation, meetings, proposals, conversions, revenue, and pipeline movement.
* Conduct performance reviews and implement corrective action where required.
* Develop a culture of accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement.

5\. Strategic Partnerships \& Market Development

* Develop referral relationships and strategic alliances.
* Build relationships with business associations, industry professionals, entrepreneurs, institutions, and potential channel partners.
* Represent ORIGENNT at relevant business meetings, conferences, networking events, and industry forums.
* Identify partnership opportunities that can contribute to business growth.

6\. Internal Coordination \& Client Success

* Coordinate with internal consulting, operations, HR, technology, branding, marketing, and execution teams.
* Ensure smooth handover of acquired clients and projects.
* Support the successful execution of client engagements.
* Monitor client satisfaction and relationship quality.
* Identify opportunities for long\-term client retention and account expansion.

7\. Reporting, CRM \& Governance

* Maintain accurate and timely CRM and pipeline records.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly business reports as required.
* Prepare revenue forecasts and pipeline reports.
* Maintain accurate records of client interactions, proposals, negotiations, and business opportunities.
* Comply with all ORIGENNT policies, reporting systems, professional standards, and management directives.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Performance shall be evaluated based on a combination of individual, team, commercial, and strategic performance indicators, including:

* Monthly revenue achievement
* New client acquisition
* Lead generation and lead quality
* Number of qualified business meetings
* Proposal submissions
* Conversion ratio
* Sales pipeline value and health
* Client retention and relationship development
* Cross\-selling and upselling performance
* Sales \& Growth Consultant productivity
* Team revenue performance
* Strategic partnerships developed
* Business expansion initiatives
* CRM and reporting discipline
* Customer satisfaction
* Overall contribution to regional and organizational objectives

QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCEEssential Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University.

Preferred Qualifications

* MBA, PGDM, or equivalent qualification in:
* Business Administration
* Marketing
* Sales
* Management
* Entrepreneurship

Experience

A minimum of **2 years of professional experience** in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Business Development
* Corporate Sales
* Management Consulting
* Client Relationship Management
* Strategic Partnerships
* Team Leadership
* B2B Sales
* Enterprise Sales

Essential Competencies

The candidate should demonstrate:

* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Strong business development capability
* Corporate presentation skills
* Negotiation and commercial understanding
* Leadership and team management ability
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving
* Analytical and decision\-making capability
* Professional client handling
* Target orientation and ownership mindset
* Ability to work independently and lead teams

Proficiency in CRM systems, Microsoft Office, business reporting tools, and digital productivity platforms will be an added advantage.

EMPLOYMENT TERMS \& BENEFITS

The selected candidate shall be appointed subject to the following terms:

Probation

The selected candidate shall undergo a **three\-month probation period**.

**₹14,500 per month during the probation period has been allocated to understand their potentials and performances with opportunity to apply for incentives and bonus policies, regards post probation candidates are allocated a fixed salary of 22,750 per month upto 40,550 per month as per their performances and matrix.**

Performance\-based incentives shall be applicable in accordance with the prevailing **ORIGENNT Incentive Policy**.

Approved official travel expenses incurred for legitimate business purposes shall be reimbursed in accordance with the Company's **Travel \& Reimbursement Policy** and applicable approval procedures within a week,

Continuation of employment and confirmation shall be subject to:

* Satisfactory performance
* Achievement of assigned objectives
* Professional conduct
* Adherence to Company policies
* Reporting discipline
* Client\-handling standards
* Successful completion of the probation period

WHY JOIN ORIGENNT?

ORIGENNT provides an entrepreneurial and high\-growth environment where leadership, initiative, innovation, and measurable performance are recognized.

The AGM will receive exposure to:

* Multiple industries and business models
* Corporate decision\-makers and business leaders
* Strategic consulting engagements
* Business growth and expansion initiatives
* Multi\-functional teams
* Sales leadership and organizational development
* Real\-world management consulting environments

This position offers a strong platform for professionals seeking long\-term growth in **Business Leadership, Management Consulting, Corporate Sales, and Strategic Business Development**.

We are a Silicon Valley based residential real estate brokerage company. We are looking for a business analyst to join our team.

As part of our operations team currently based in Kerala, the business analyst will work on various functional areas including researching residential real estate properties in California, assist with marketing / digital marketing initiatives, communicating with our clients, research on analytics and help run the business operations of the company. This position will be an integral part of the business development, operations and customer experience for the company.

The ideal candidate will be an excellent communicator, a quick learner, have excellent analytical skills, and reasonably well\-versed with computers. A good academic background and/or professional track record would be highly desirable.

Personal integrity and total honesty in everything you do is a non\-negotiable requirement. Please check your resume for accuracy before applying. Good verbal and written communication skills in English needed. Bachelors degree is required, preferably in Science, Business, Management, Engineering, Finance or Mathematics. While freshers may be considered, those with work experience in any field and those who are based in Kerala will be given preference since the rest of the team is in Kerala.

title: BMS Engineer
description:
**Job Title: BMS Engineer (Building Management System)**

**Job Summary:**  
The BMS Engineer is responsible for the installation, testing, commissioning, programming, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Building Management Systems (BMS) and integrated ELV systems. The engineer ensures all systems operate efficiently according to project specifications and client requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, test, and commission BMS systems.
* Read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, and BMS layouts.
* Program and configure BMS controllers, HMI, and SCADA systems.
* Integrate HVAC, Fire Alarm, Chiller, AHU, FCU, VFD, Lighting, DG, and Energy Monitoring systems.
* Perform I/O testing, point\-to\-point checking, and functional testing.
* Troubleshoot BMS hardware, software, and communication network issues.
* Prepare commissioning reports, as\-built drawings, and technical documentation.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, and MEP contractors during project execution.
* Attend site meetings and provide technical support.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards and project quality requirements.
* Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance of BMS systems.

**Required Skills**

* Good knowledge of HVAC controls and automation.
* Experience with PLC, DDC Controllers, HMI, and SCADA.
* Knowledge of communication protocols:
* BACnet
* Modbus RTU/TCP
* KNX
* LonWorks
* OPC
* Understanding of electrical control panels and instrumentation.
* Ability to read AutoCAD drawings and electrical schematics.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or Automation Engineering.
* 2–5 years of experience in BMS installation, commissioning, or maintenance (or fresher with relevant training).

**Preferred Experience**

Experience with one or more BMS platforms such as:

* Siemens Desigo
* Honeywell EBI
* Schneider EcoStruxure
* Johnson Controls Metasys
* Delta Controls
* Distech Controls
* ABB
* Tridium Niagara

**Key Responsibilities on Site**

* Site survey and planning
* Cable inspection and termination
* Panel testing
* Controller programming
* Sensor calibration
* Functional testing
* Client demonstration
* Final commissioning
* AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) support

This job description is suitable for **commercial buildings, hospitals, hotels, IT parks, industrial plants, malls, and data centers** where Building Management Systems are installed.

Pay: From ₹300,000\.00 per year

Position Overview:


The Ops Staff is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


Job Purpose:


To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


Key Roles \& Responsibilities:


Shipment Processing \& Operations

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.


Data Entry \& Operational Documentation

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.

* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.


Safety, Security \& Compliance

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.

* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.


Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


Qualifications \& Experience:


Education:

* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:

* Fresher or up to 2 years of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.


Eligibility Requirements:

* Minimum age 18 years.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


Skills \& Capabilities:


Technical Skills:

* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills

* Maintain content calendars, campaign documentation, and marketing reports.

description:
Job description:

**Job Description:**  
**Area Placement Manager**

**Company Overview**

ICA Edu Skills Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's premier vocational training and skill development institutes, specialized in accounts, finance, taxation, and digital skills. We are dedicated to bridging the gap between education and employment by delivering job\-guaranteed courses and securing meaningful career starts for our students.

* **Position Title:** Area Placement Manager / Placement Manager

* **Match and screen candidate profiles** precisely against employer requirements prior to resume sharing.
* **Coordinate interview loops** seamlessly, compiling feedback from HRs to share with the internal training faculties.

**3\. Student Readiness \& Retention Tracking**

* **Monitor candidate preparation** by tracking attendance in Group Discussions and Personal Interview (GDPI) workshops.
* **Track 3\-month employment retention** by conducting post\-placement check\-ins with both corporate clients and placed alumni.

**4\. Team Leadership \& Strategy**

* **Manage a localized team** of placement executives, setting clear monthly sourcing and placement goals.
* **Travel across North India** (including Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, and UP) to support franchise networks with local hiring drives.
* **Maintain rigorous MIS reports**, documenting all pipelines, corporate visits, and placement metrics for management reviews

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** Graduate or Post\-Graduate degree (MBA in HR or Marketing is highly preferred).
* **Network:** Pre\-existing network of HR contacts in BFSI, IT, retail, or manufacturing sectors across Delhi NCR.
* **Communication:** Exceptional English and Hindi verbal communication skills to influence corporate decision\-makers.
* **Tech\-Savvy:** Strong working command over MS Excel, G\-Suite, and regional recruitment portals.
* **Mindset:** Target\-driven professional comfortable handling high\-volume fresher placement pipelines.

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

About DHL Blue Dart Express India:  

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
Position Overview:
The Ops Staff is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.
The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.
Job Purpose:
To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.  

Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
Shipment Processing \& Operations* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

  

Data Entry \& Operational Documentation* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

  

Operational Support* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

  

Safety, Security \& Compliance* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

  

Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.

  

Qualifications \& Experience:
Education:* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

  

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

  

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.

  

Skills \& Capabilities:
Technical Skills:* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

  

Key Competencies:* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


Key Performance Indicators:  

KRAs KPIs
Operational Productivity Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence
Quality \& Accuracy Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy
Safety \& Compliance SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations
Operational Discipline Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline
Teamwork \& Operational Support Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning  

Why join DHL Blue Dart?
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).

description:
**Job Title** **Operations Staff** **Function** **Operations** **Reports To**  

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable) **Location** **Branch / Service Centre / Hub / Warehouse / PUD (Location Agnostic)** **Travel Required** **25%****þ****50%****75%**  

About DHL Blue Dart Express India:  

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
Position Overview:
The Ops Staff is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.
The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.
Job Purpose:
To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.  

Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
Shipment Processing \& Operations* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

  

Data Entry \& Operational Documentation* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

  

Operational Support* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

  

Safety, Security \& Compliance* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

  

Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.

  

Qualifications \& Experience:
Education:* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

  

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

  

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.

  

Skills \& Capabilities:
Technical Skills:* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

  

Key Competencies:* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


Key Performance Indicators:  

KRAs KPIs
Operational Productivity Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence
Quality \& Accuracy Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy
Safety \& Compliance SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations
Operational Discipline Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline
Teamwork \& Operational Support Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning  

Why join DHL Blue Dart?
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.  

Disclaimer:
At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).
Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.
Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

As an AI Creative Assistant, you will work closely with the founder to brainstorm ideas, conduct research, create content, and use AI\-powered tools to improve the quality and speed of creative work.

* A student, fresher, intern, or early\-career professional

* Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools
* Creative and able to contribute original ideas
* Good at online research and identifying useful information
* Able to write clear and engaging English
* Organised, responsible, and able to meet deadlines
* Comfortable receiving feedback and improving your work

Preferred Skills

* LinkedIn content writing
* Social\-media management
* Canva design
* Basic video editing
* Prompt writing and AI\-assisted research
* Personal branding
* Content planning
* Digital marketing
* No\-code automation
* Presentation creation

Previous professional experience is not mandatory. Personal projects, college projects, sample content, or examples of work created using AI tools will also be considered.

Work Details

* **Location:** Work from home

The final stipend will depend on the candidate’s skills, availability, creativity, and ability to work independently.

* Practical experience using AI tools in real projects
* Exposure to content creation, personal branding, research, and digital strategy

* Direct collaboration with the founder

* Identify new sourcing clusters and build market linkages in potential agri\-growing regions.

**3\. Supply Chain \& Operational Support**

* Coordinate logistics, transportation, and last\-mile pickup from sourcing locations to warehouses or processing centers.

* Assist in planning procurement volumes based on demand forecasts and operational needs.

**Key Personal Attributes**

* Proactive, reliable, and able to work independently.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work at the intersection of agriculture, technology, and supply chain innovation.
