**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced AWS \& Azure Network Engineer with strong expertise in cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, network security, and enterprise routing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, supporting, and troubleshooting network infrastructure across AWS, Azure, SD\-WAN, and on\-premises environments while ensuring high availability, security, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Networking \- AWS \& Azure :**
* Design, implement, and manage AWS and Azure networking solutions across multi\-cloud and hybrid environments.
* Configure and troubleshoot AWS VPCs, Subnets, Route Tables, Transit Gateways, VPC Peering, Direct Connect, and VPN connectivity.
* Configure and troubleshoot Azure VNets, Subnets, User Defined Routes (UDRs), VNet Peering, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateways, and NSGs.
* Support hybrid cloud connectivity between AWS, Azure, data centers, and remote sites.


**Routing, Switching \& WAN**
* Perform advanced troubleshooting of routing, switching, WAN, and cloud networking issues.
* Manage and optimize BGP, OSPF, static routing, route redistribution, NAT, and VPN technologies.
* Support and troubleshoot SD\-WAN environments including traffic steering, WAN optimization, and site connectivity.


**Network Security**
* Configure, administer, and troubleshoot FortiGate and Check Point firewalls.
* Collaborate with security teams to implement firewall policies and network security controls.
* Manage and troubleshoot Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) integrations and secure internet access solutions.


**Operations \& Documentation**
* Conduct network performance analysis and implement improvements for availability and resiliency.
* Participate in incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and problem management activities.
* Create and maintain network architecture diagrams, SOPs, and technical documentation.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Strong working knowledge of Azure networking services : VNet, Subnets, UDRs, VNet Peering, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, and NSGs.
* Solid understanding of routing protocols BGP, OSPF, static routing, and route redistribution.
* Hands\-on experience with NAT and VPN technologies (site\-to\-site, point\-to\-site, client VPN).
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting FortiGate and/or Check Point firewalls.
* Experience with SD\-WAN platforms and traffic steering/WAN optimization concepts.
* Experience with Zscaler ZIA/ZPA or similar secure access/SASE solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills across network, security, and cloud layers.
* Ability to create clear network architecture diagrams and technical documentation.


**Good To Have**
* AWS or Azure networking certifications (e.g., AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, Azure Network Engineer Associate).
* Fortinet NSE or Check Point CCSA/CCSE certification.
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform/CloudFormation/ARM templates) for network provisioning.
* Exposure to ITSM tools for incident and change management.

BILARA GROUP is an architectural and construction company based in Kochi, Kerala, known for its innovative design solutions and high\-quality construction services. We specialize in delivering residential projects that stand out for their precision, craftsmanship, and sustainability.

We are looking for a highly skilled Civil Site Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the construction site’s day\-to\-day operations, ensuring the project’s adherence to design specifications, safety standards, timelines, and quality requirements.

title: Software Development Engineer - I
description:
**About GoKwik**
 GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, powering merchants across checkout optimisation, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables 15,000\+ merchants globally, processes \~$2 billion in GMV, and is rapidly scaling across India, the UK, Europe, and the US. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments, GoKwik has raised $68 million in funding, including a $13 million growth round in June 2025, and is building AI\-powered infrastructure to shape the future of eCommerce.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer \- I, you'll build the backend systems that power millions of eCommerce transactions and experiences. From checkout and payments to RTO reduction and merchant\-facing products, you'll write production\-grade code, ship customer\-facing features, and work alongside experienced engineers to build scalable, reliable systems. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership early while developing deep technical expertise in distributed systems and modern backend engineering.
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

* Build, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and NestJS, with exposure to Go as part of the engineering stack.
* Develop scalable APIs and backend systems using PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
* Contribute to event\-driven architectures using Kafka and collaborate with senior engineers on distributed systems.
* Ship end\-to\-end features, including frontend contributions using React and Svelte when required.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code while participating in peer code reviews.
* Debug production issues, identify root causes, and implement long\-term solutions.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and deployments on AWS.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver high\-quality product experiences.


 Who You Are
   

  

* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and problem\-solving fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Exposure to Go, Redis, or Kafka is an advantage.
* Comfortable contributing across the stack, including frontend technologies like React or Svelte.
* Curious, proactive, and eager to learn while taking ownership of engineering challenges.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
Professor Academy is seeking an experienced and performance\-driven
 **Senior HR Manager** 
 to lead performance appraisal systems and operations. The candidate will be responsible for developing measurable performance standards, monitoring employee productivity, managing the employee lifecycle, strengthening HR policies, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operations.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Performance Management and Appraisal** 



* Design, implement, and continuously improve the organization’s performance appraisal system.
* Develop role\-specific Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Key Result Areas (KRAs), and measurable performance standards.
* Establish monthly, quarterly, half\-yearly, and annual performance review processes.
* Coordinate probation reviews, confirmation assessments, salary revisions, promotions, and performance improvement plans.
* Collect and validate performance data from department heads and reporting managers.
* Analyse individual, departmental, and organizational performance trends.
* Identify underperformance and coordinate corrective actions, coaching, training, or performance improvement plans.
* Ensure appraisals are objective, evidence\-based, consistent, and completed within prescribed timelines.
* Maintain appraisal records, ratings, feedback, and supporting documentation.
* Provide management with performance dashboards and recommendations for promotions, increments, rewards, role changes, or corrective action.
* Train managers and employees on appraisal processes, goal setting, feedback, and performance documentation.



**Policy and Compliance Management** 



* Develop, review, and implement policies, standard operating procedures, and employee guidelines.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, reports, and compliance documentation.
* Coordinate with legal consultants, auditors, government authorities, and external service providers when required.
* Conduct periodic HR audits and address identified gaps.



**Eligibility Criteria** 



* **MBA in Human Resource Management is mandatory.**
* **Minimum five years of relevant HR experience in performance appraisal and operations, including experience as an HR Manager, Senior HR Executive, or Operations Manager.**
* **Candidates from the hospital, healthcare, education, coaching institute, or EdTech industry will be preferred.**
* **Hands\-on experience in developing and managing KPIs, KRAs, performance appraisals, and Performance Improvement Plans.**
* **Strong knowledge of payroll, employee lifecycle management, employee relations, HR policies, Indian labour laws, and statutory compliance.**
* **Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and HRMS software.**



**Required Skills and Competencies** 



* Strong leadership and team\-management abilities.
* Excellent analytical and performance\-assessment skills.
* Ability to develop measurable goals and interpret performance data.
* Strong knowledge of HR operations and employee relations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Sound decision\-making and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information.
* High level of professionalism, fairness, integrity, and attention to detail.

description:
**Company Description** 




 Season Two, the senior care brand of SP Life Care, is dedicated to transforming the lives of older adults in India through comprehensive lifestyle, health, and social support. Recognizing that existing care ecosystems have not kept pace with rising life expectancy, Season Two is building personalized care solutions powered by pioneering digital interventions. The organization operates senior living homes and home care services, with a prototype facility in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala that offers independent and assisted living, an Ayurveda center, family health center, yoga, physiotherapy, and dining facilities. With a committed investment of over US $50 million, Season Two is expanding services to Bangalore and Kochi, and partnering with technology and healthcare startups to build specialized senior care offerings.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Human Resource Manager will be responsible for developing and executing HR strategies that support the organizational goals of Season Two Senior Living. This role involves overseeing recruitment, training, employee engagement, performance management, HR compliance, and the creation of a positive and service\-oriented workplace culture that reflects the company’s values of empathy, respect, and excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding
 


* Develop and implement staffing strategies to attract, hire, and retain high quality talent across all levels, especially care staff, hospitality professionals, and administrators.
* Collaborate with department heads to forecast hiring needs.
* Oversee end\-to\-end recruitment processes including job postings, interviews, background checks, and offer negotiations.
* Lead employee onboarding and orientation programs to ensure smooth integration and alignment with company culture.



 2\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
 


* Foster a supportive and inclusive work environment that reflects the compassionate ethos of senior care.
* Address employee grievances promptly and in accordance with company policy.
* Organize employee engagement initiatives, wellness programs, and teambuilding activities.
* Conduct regular feedback sessions and stay interviews to ensure staff satisfaction and retention.



 3\. Training \& Development
 


* Identify training needs and coordinate professional development programs for staff.
* Collaborate with healthcare and hospitality experts to design specialized training for caregiving, safety, and customer service.
* Promote a continuous learning culture across the organization.



 4\. Performance Management
 


* Develop and manage performance evaluation systems and KPI frameworks.
* Support managers in setting clear performance goals and providing constructive feedback.
* Coordinate annual appraisals, salary revisions, and promotion cycles. 5\. Policy Development \& Compliance
* Ensure HR policies and procedures comply with local labour laws and industry standards.
* Maintain up\-to\-date employee handbooks, contracts, and legal documentation.
* Implement systems for record\-keeping, HR metrics, and audit\-readiness.



 6\. HR Operations \& Administration
 


* Maintain HRIS (Human Resource Information Systems) and ensure accurate data management.
* Oversee payroll coordination in collaboration with finance.
* Manage employee benefits, leave policies, and attendance systems.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements:** 



* Master's degree in Human Resource Management or of similar nature.
* Minimum 5\-7 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in healthcare, hospitality, or service industries.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and HR best practices.
* Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Empathetic, detail\-oriented, and aligned with the values of senior care.
* Proficient in MS Office and HRIS platforms.



  





**Preferred Qualities:** 



* Prior experience in a senior living, healthcare, or customer\-centric environment.
* Multilingual abilities (English and Malayalam preferred).
* Passion for working in a purpose\-driven organization with a social impact.

title: Senior HR Manager (India Tech Center)
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Team**
 Our India Technology Center (ITC) is a rapidly growing organization supporting global technology and digital initiatives across Williams\-Sonoma. With a strong base of engineering and product talent, ITC plays a critical role in delivering innovation, scalability, and business impact across our global platforms.
   

  

 The HR team partners closely with Technology leadership and associates to attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent. We are focused on building high\-performing teams, delivering data\-driven people solutions, and fostering an inclusive, high\-performance culture aligned with global priorities.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior HR Manager is a strategic, hands\-on partner who will play a key role in shaping the people agenda for the India Technology Center (ITC). In this role, you will work closely with senior Technology leaders (Director/VP level), helping translate business priorities into meaningful people strategies that enable teams to do their best work.
   

  

 You’ll be at the heart of building a high\-performing, inclusive, and scalable organization—driving initiatives across HR Business Partnership, Talent Development, and HR Operations. From strengthening leadership capability to enhancing employee experience, your work will directly impact how our teams grow and succeed.
   

  

 While you will partner closely with Talent Acquisition leadership to ensure hiring strategies are aligned with business needs and support ITC’s continued growth, the scope of this role may evolve over time to include broader responsibilities in this area.
   

  

 You’ll also partner with U.S. and global HR teams, gaining exposure to a truly international environment and helping bring together global best practices with local insights.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
**Business Partnership**
* Partner with Technology leaders to align workforce strategy with business goals, including org design and workforce planning
* Provide coaching to managers on leadership capability, performance management, and team effectiveness
* Use HR analytics to identify trends (attrition, engagement, performance) and recommend actionable interventions
* Support and lead change management initiatives with structured execution and communication


**Performance, Development \& Engagement**
* Drive performance management processes including goal setting, reviews, and development planning
* Partner with leaders on talent reviews, succession planning, and capability building
* Design and implement engagement initiatives based on survey insights
* Build manager capability through structured training and coaching programs


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* Partner with Global Total Rewards team on compensation benchmarking and reward strategies
* Provide insights on market competitiveness and retention strategies
* Ensure effective communication and understanding of benefits programs among associates


**Associate Relations**
* Provide guidance on associate relations matters including performance concerns, investigations, and exits
* Ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant resolution aligned with company values
* Proactively identify and mitigate employee relations risks


**HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws and statutory requirements (e.g., Shops \& Establishment Act, POSH, PF, Gratuity)
* Maintain HRIS (Oracle) data integrity and leverage analytics for workforce insights
* Partner with Legal, Payroll, and Global HR teams for operational excellence and audit readiness
* Adapt global policies to align with local legal and cultural requirements


**People Leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing HR team
* Set clear priorities aligned with business needs and drive accountability for outcomes
* Build HR capability to support organizational scale and maturity
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performance team culture grounded in trust and continuous improvement


**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding**
* Partner closely with Talent Acquisition and ITC leadership to support hiring strategies aligned with business growth and workforce plans
* Provide input into workforce planning, role prioritization, and hiring needs based on evolving business objectives
* Collaborate to ensure strong alignment on candidate profiles, hiring quality, and overall candidate experience
* Contribute to building effective onboarding experiences that enable strong integration and early productivity of new hires
* Support continuous improvement of hiring and onboarding practices, with the potential to take on broader responsibilities in this area over time
* Oversee associate’s onboarding programs to ensure effective integration and early productivity of new hires


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related field or equivalent work experience
* 8–10 years of progressive HR experience, including HRBP and talent development experience
* Experience in global or matrixed organizations, preferably in product companies or Global Capability Centers (GCCs)
* Proven experience supporting Technology/Engineering organizations in high\-growth environments
* Experience partnering with Talent Acquisition teams or exposure to hiring strategies in high\-growth environments
* Strong understanding of the Indian talent market, especially in major tech hubs
* Deep knowledge of Indian labor laws and compliance requirements
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and manage complex stakeholder environments
* Experience scaling organizations and managing high\-volume hiring
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using HR data to drive decisions
* High ownership and ability to operate in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a drive for results
* Learning agility and adaptability to evolving business needs
* High integrity and commitment to fostering a respectful, inclusive workplace
* This role requires being onsite in the Pune, India office 3 \- 4 days per week


**Why Join Williams\-Sonoma India Technology Center**
* Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well\-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.
* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high\-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.
* Build and operate large\-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.
* Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting\-edge technologies, AI\-driven solutions, and large\-scale engineering challenges.
* Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with in\-office days for team engagement.


**About Us**
 Founded in 1956, Williams\-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high\-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e\-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams\-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Williams\-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, GreenRow and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide.
   

  

 Williams\-Sonoma has established a technology center in Pune, India to enhance its global operations. The India Technology Center serves as a critical hub for innovation and focuses on developing cutting\-edge solutions in areas such as e\-commerce, supply chain optimization, and customer experience management. By integrating advanced technologies like artificial intelligence, data analytics, and machine learning, the India Technology Center plays a crucial role in accelerating Williams\-Sonoma's growth and maintaining its competitive edge in the global market

description:
**About The Role**
 Instavision Inc. is looking for a dependable, highly organized Office Manager, Administrator to keep our workplace running smoothly day to day. This is a hands\-on operations and administration role at the center of the office; you will own facilities, vendor relationships, scheduling, supplies, and the steady stream of administrative tasks that keep teams productive.
   

  

 We strongly encourage candidates with a Human Resources background to apply. While the core of this position is office and administrative management, HR experience is a valued, preferred qualification. You will partner closely with our People team and may take on people\-operations tasks such as onboarding logistics, recordkeeping, and coordinating employee events.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage daily office operations, ensuring a clean, safe, well\-stocked, and welcoming workplace.
* Oversee facilities and vendor relationships, including supplies, equipment, maintenance, cleaning, and building management.
* Maintain office budgets, track expenses, process invoices, and reconcile receipts.
* Coordinate calendars, meetings, travel, and logistics for leadership and visiting guests.
* Serve as the first point of contact for the office, greeting visitors, handling mail and deliveries, and fielding general inquiries.
* Support new\-hire onboarding logistics, workspace setup, access badges, equipment, and welcome materials.
* Maintain accurate administrative and employee records, ensuring confidentiality and compliance with company policy.
* Plan and coordinate company events, team gatherings, and internal communications.
* Identify and implement improvements to office processes, tools, and workflows.
* Experience scheduling multi\-stage interviews, coordinating calendars, and managing timely candidate follow\-ups.
* Onboarding Execution: Hands\-on experience welcoming new hires, preparing starter kits, and guiding employees through day\-one paperwork.
* Asset \& Inventory Tracking: Proven ability to monitor, stock, and reorder office supplies while meticulously logging company assets like laptops and equipment.
* Facilities \& IT Operations: Experience managing day\-to\-day office utilities, troubleshooting internet connectivity issues, and coordinating with vendors.
* Event Coordination: Strong organizational skills to plan, set up, and manage internal company events, team\-building activities, and celebrations.


**Required Qualifications**
* 2–5 years of experience in office management, administration, executive support, or a similar role.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and a professional, approachable manner.
* Proficiency with office and productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office).
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* High level of discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information.


**Preferred Qualifications**
+ Background or prior experience in Human Resources (HR generalist, HR coordinator, recruiting, or people operations).
+ Familiarity with HR processes such as onboarding, recordkeeping, benefits administration, or HRIS tools.
+ Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field.
+ Experience supporting a growing or technology\-focused company.
+ Working knowledge of basic bookkeeping or expense\-management tools. What We Offer
- Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
- Comprehensive health coverage.
- Paid time off and company holidays.
- A collaborative, supportive team and a central role in shaping our workplace.
- Opportunities to grow into broader operations or people\-operations responsibilities. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit a resume and a brief cover letter outlining their relevant experience. Instavision Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Resource Planning Specialist
description:
At Emerald Clinical, we are a global, full\-service Contract Research Organization (CRO) with a rich heritage in the Asia\-Pacific region. We are dedicated to advancing clinical research through scientific expertise and operational excellence, supporting biopharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic customers across all trial phases, from registration to post\-marketing.
   

  

 Our therapeutic expertise spans renal, cardiometabolic, and oncology—areas where we make a significant impact on improving global health.
   

  

 At the heart of our success is our ability to combine global reach with local knowledge. Our on\-the\-ground teams work closely with local communities, building trust and ensuring diverse, representative patient recruitment. By prioritizing people, we deliver better engagement, more accurate data, and faster results—bringing therapies to patients in need.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Resourcing Specialist is responsible for supporting the effective allocation and management of resources across the organization to ensure clinical studies are appropriately staffed. Working closely with Clinical Operations leaders, Project Managers, Functional Managers, and Human Resources, the role monitors resource capacity, utilisation, and forecasting to support efficient project delivery while balancing employee development and business priorities.
   

  

 The Resourcing Specialist plays a key role in workforce planning, maintaining resource data, and providing insight to support strategic resourcing decisions at Emerald Clinical
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Resource Planning and Allocation**
* Coordinate the allocation of resources across clinical projects based on study requirements, timelines, employee availability, skills, and experience.
* Work with functional managers and project teams to identify appropriate personnel for new and ongoing studies.
* Monitor resource demand and capacity to ensure optimal utilisation across the organisation.
* Support rapid resource deployment for priority projects and changing business needs.


**Capacity Management**
* Maintain accurate records of resource availability, planned assignments, leave, and utilisation.
* Track employee workloads to identify over\- or under\-utilisation.
* Highlight potential resource constraints and recommend solutions to minimise delivery risks.
* Support long\-term workforce planning through capacity forecasting.


**Forecasting and Reporting**
* Produce regular reports on resource utilisation, capacity, project demand, and staffing forecasts.
* Analyse trends to support recruitment planning and operational decision\-making.
* Maintain resource planning tools and ensure data accuracy.
* Provide management with insights to support strategic workforce decisions.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Partner with Clinical Operations, Project Management, Department Heads, Talent Acquisition, and Human Resources to align resource plans with business priorities.
* Participate in project planning meetings to understand upcoming resource requirements.
* Communicate resource availability and allocation changes to relevant stakeholders.
* Support resolution of resource conflicts through effective coordination and negotiation.


**Process Improvement**
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of resource management processes, systems, and reporting.
* Identify opportunities to improve resource planning efficiency and data quality.
* Support implementation of resource management tools and best practices.


**Compliance and Data Integrity**
* Ensure resource data is maintained accurately within resource management and project management systems.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.
* Adhere to company policies, SOPs, and applicable quality standards.


**Training, Quality and Compliance**
* Complete mandatory training for this role within specified timelines
* Attend mandatory training sessions required for this role
* Identify resources and training to support learning and development within this role
* Comply with all applicable regulations, guidelines, SOPs and project\-specific requirements
* Comply with all designated systems relevant to this role
* Ensure own quality control of all relevant processes and activities performed
* Report and escalate identified risks and issues in areas of responsibility according to Emerald Clinical and/or project requirements


**Customer Focus and Teamwork**
* Attend and actively participate in Emerald Clinical meetings and other internal meetings and activities as required
* Provide input to systems, tools and processes to support continuous improvement
* Share knowledge with others, to facilitate learning and development across the organisation


**Work Health and Safety**
* Comply with Work Health \& Safety (WH\&S) legislation and operate in accordance with established organisational WH\&S practice and procedures
* Promote and contribute to a safe, secure environment for staff and visitors


**About You**
* A bachelor’s degree in business, Life Sciences, Project Management, or a related field is preferred.
* Relevant equivalent experience will also be considered in place of formal qualifications.
* 1 \-5 years of resource planning, workforce management, project coordination, or clinical operations ideally within a CRO, pharmaceutical, or healthcare setting.
* Familiarity with working in a matrix organisation.
* An understanding of clinical trial processes is is advantageous


**Additional Requirements**
 Motivated team player with a keen interest in resourcing, who can also take initiative and work independently.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 At our core, Emerald Clinical is committed to transforming clinical research by putting people first—both patients and our employees. By joining our team, you’ll be part of a global network of passionate professionals working together to deliver better research and outcomes for millions worldwide.
   

  

**Here’s What Makes Us Stand Out**
* Purpose\-Driven Work: You’ll contribute to clinical trials that genuinely improve lives, with a focus on therapies in renal, cardiometabolic, and oncology.
* Global Reach, Local Expertise: Our teams connect with local communities, building trust and meaningful engagement for every trial.
* Collaboration and Innovation: Work in a culture that values diverse perspectives and creative solutions to solve global health challenges.


**What We Offer**
 We understand that great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That’s why we provide:
   

  

* Competitive Compensation: A tailored salary and benefits package to reflect your skills and experience.
* Flexibility: Enjoy hybrid or remote working arrangements, depending on your location and role.
* Career Growth: Access to a wealth of learning opportunities and a global network of scientific leaders to help you grow and develop in your role.
* Employee Wellbeing: Participate in programs and initiatives designed to promote work\-life balance, health, and team connection, including global engagement surveys, recognition programs, and team\-building events.
* Global Opportunities: Be part of a company with international reach, offering you exposure to diverse projects and clients.


 Interested? Apply now and help us achieve our mission to improve the health of millions worldwide.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?
   

  

 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
   

  

 In the post\-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
   

  

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes that support analytics, reporting, and machine learning workloads.
* You'll own the day\-to\-day reliability of data ingestion processes, proactively troubleshooting pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, and data anomalies.
* You'll refactor and modernise existing ETL processes to improve efficiency, standardisation, and scalability.
* You'll reduce manual data movement through automation and the implementation of consistent engineering best practices.
* You'll support schema changes, incremental data loads, and the onboarding of new data sources and elements.
* You'll develop and optimise data models and data warehouse structures to ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability.
* You'll assist with database performance tuning, indexing strategies, and schema management activities.
* You'll deliver well\-structured, production\-ready datasets that enable analytics and data science teams to generate meaningful insights.
* You'll collaborate with engineering and analytics teams across multiple geographies to integrate data from diverse sources while ensuring consistent data quality standards.
* You'll write and optimise SQL queries to validate data completeness, accuracy, and integrity.
* You'll reconcile ETL outputs against source system reports, identifying and resolving data quality issues where required.
* You'll manage API\-based integrations, including handling pagination, rate limiting, and incremental data extraction processes.
* You'll work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders across time zones to understand business data requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* You'll actively participate in asynchronous workflows and virtual collaboration environments to maintain alignment across distributed teams.
* You'll communicate project progress, risks, blockers, and outcomes clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You'll implement monitoring, logging, and automation solutions to improve pipeline stability and minimise manual intervention.
* You'll create and maintain runbooks, ETL documentation, and process guides to support operational excellence and knowledge sharing.
* You'll follow and reinforce engineering standards covering naming conventions, development structures, and deployment practices.
* You'll support change management processes, version control, and controlled releases to ensure reliable and secure deployments.


**And what are we looking for?**
* You'll bring a Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* You'll have 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, ETL development, or a related technical role.
* You'll demonstrate experience working within offshore, distributed, or globally dispersed teams, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple time zones.
* You'll possess a solid understanding of ETL concepts, data integration principles, and data pipeline architecture.
* You'll have hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) or a comparable ETL and data orchestration platform.
* You'll be experienced in working with REST APIs, including interpreting documentation, handling JSON payloads, and managing authentication methods such as API keys, OAuth, and tokens.
* You'll have strong SQL and Python skills, including expertise in joins, aggregations, filtering, troubleshooting, and performance optimisation.
* You'll bring familiarity with cloud\-based data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.
* You'll have experience using source code management and version control tools such as Git.
* You'll have knowledge of Vincilium or similar ETL tools.
* You'll bring exposure to Power BI datasets and backend reporting models that support business intelligence solutions.
* You'll have experience working with file\-based integrations, including CSV, Excel, and SFTP\-based data transfers.
* You'll demonstrate familiarity with insurance platforms and/or ERP and CRM systems.
* You'll be highly detail\-oriented, with a strong commitment to data accuracy, quality, and reliability.
* You'll be a proactive and self\-managing communicator who keeps remote stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned.
* You'll be comfortable working independently across multiple time zones with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* You'll be collaborative and team\-oriented, recognising that successful data engineering outcomes are achieved through strong cross\-functional partnerships regardless of location.
* You'll be eager to learn, grow, and take on increasing levels of ownership as the platform and team continue to evolve.
* You'll have the opportunity to progress into more senior data engineering or platform architecture roles, taking greater ownership of ingestion architecture, driving standardisation across new data sources, and contributing to the growth and maturity of the wider data platform.


**So, why choose us?**
 We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.
   

  

 We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
   

  

 Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
   

  

 Career growth. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business \- not for the business!
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
   

  

 Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
   

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**
* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.


 Apply today and let’s go great places together!

title: Associate Threat Response Analyst
description:
**Associate Threat Response Analyst – Threat Response Operations**
**About Mimecast**
 Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications. With over 42,000 customers worldwide, Mimecast has a long history of excellence in Data Archiving and eDiscovery and is recognised as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving Solutions.
   

  

 We are pioneers in Human Risk Management, recognizing that people are both an organization's greatest asset and its most significant security vulnerability. Our platform addresses the human element of cybersecurity through advanced threat detection, awareness training, Incydr risk management, and data governance. Our Governance, Compliance \& Insight products play a critical role in this mission, ensuring that communications data is archived, discoverable, and compliant, enabling organizations to manage the risk that stems from human actions.
   

  

**AI\-First Engineering at Mimecast**
 Mimecast is an AI\-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI\-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.
   

  

 Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI tooling and AI\-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide.
   

  

**The driving force behind Security Response at Mimecast**
 As a Threat Response Analyst, you will be joining the Mimecast Threat Response Operations team and will be responsible for supporting on\-demand threat resolution for our customers. The service is designed to provide customers with prompt feedback and intelligence on email\-borne threats, remediate these threats from their email environment to reduce dwell time, and put the appropriate detections in place to prevent further incidents from occurring. The role may require working afternoon/evening shifts and being part of a rotation for holiday support.
   

  

 Threat Response team ensures that our security\-focused solutions are performing accurately and efficiently, thereby keeping our customers safe amidst a rapidly evolving threat landscape. Through threat research and customer feedback we identify where our security products can be improved for better detection of security threats.
   

  

 Threat Response works closely with research and development, as well as customer support. We are a global team that spans three continents.
   

  

**Why Join Our Team?**
*“If you’re interested in detecting and solving real\-world security problems, the Threat Response Operations team is for you. At Mimecast, we process over a billion emails and collaboration events each day. We use customer feedback, data from Threat Research and advancements in AI to keep our customers safe from threat actors, with speed and precision! With our focus on proactive, rather than reactive, approaches to threat detection,* 
*we play a key role in maintaining Mimecast’s exceptional reputation as a leading email and collaboration security provider.* 
 ” – Hiring Manager.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Analyze phishing/malicious email campaigns to identify IOCs
* Categorize email threats and determine the optimal methods to update detection
* Provide email security advice, expertise, and remediation to our customers
* Understand security policies within the Mimecast Administration Console and provide configuration suggestions to customers
* Research and investigate the latest security threats and their potential impact on Mimecast customers
* Work with security vendors on threat detection techniques and remediation
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and systems


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience and understanding of email security technologies: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
* Strong understanding of SMTP, SSL/TLS, POP3, IMAP, TCP/IP
* Working knowledge of messaging (email traffic management) and routing
* Strong understanding of Domain Name System (DNS)
* Strong understanding of URL structure, including components like protocols, domains, subdomains, paths, and query parameters
* Experience working with email/malware detection and blocking techniques
* Experience working with threat intelligence platforms
* Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into customer\-friendly responses
* Curiosity about the infrastructure of phishing/malicious email campaigns
* Working within SaaS environments.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC)
* Experience with Mimecast products as an administrator.


**What We Bring**
 Join our Threat Reporting and Response team to accelerate your career journey, working with cutting\-edge technologies and contributing to projects that have real customer impact. You will be immersed in a dynamic environment that recognizes and celebrates your achievements.
   

  

 Mimecast offers formal and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, maintains a comprehensive benefits package that helps our employees and their family members sustain a healthy lifestyle, and importantly \- working in cross\-functional teams to build your knowledge!
   

  

 We believe in ‘growth that’s good, we have ‘a culture that cares’ and we are on a ‘mission that matters’.
   

  

**Our Hybrid Model:** 
 We provide you with the flexibility to live balanced, healthy lives through our hybrid working model that champions both collaborative teamwork and individual flexibility. Employees are expected to come to the office at least two days per week, because working together in person:
   

  

* Fosters a culture of collaboration, communication, performance and learning
* Drives innovation and creativity within and between teams
* Introduces employees to priorities outside of their immediate realm
* Ensures important interpersonal relationships and connections with one another and our community!


**Belonging at Mimecast**
 Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
   

  

 We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
   

  

 We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.
   

  

*Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.*
*It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.*

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
 You’ll be a senior hands\-on Network Engineer at the center of highly available, global infrastructure. You’ll design, run, and improve enterprise and data center networks that thousands of users and critical applications rely on every day.
   

  

 You’ll work across routing, switching, firewalls, SD‑WAN, and load balancing, primarily using Cisco, Fortinet, and F5 technologies. You’ll be the person others turn to for complex troubleshooting, resilient network design, and modernization initiatives across enterprise and private cloud environments.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving tough networking problems, shaping network architecture, and partnering with security, cloud, and operations teams to keep things fast, secure, and reliable, this role gives you room to grow your technical depth and influence.
   

  

**Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff)**
* Design, deploy, and support enterprise and private cloud network infrastructure across production and non‑production environments.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex Layer 2/Layer 3 issues in mission‑critical, high‑availability networks.
* Configure and optimize Cisco Catalyst and Nexus platforms, including WAN, campus, and data center networking with BGP and OSPF.
* Support and maintain Fortinet FortiGate firewalls (including VPNs, SD‑WAN, and segmentation) to deliver secure, resilient connectivity.
* Administer and fine‑tune F5 BIG‑IP load balancing and application delivery services to keep customer and internal applications highly available.
* Lead incident/root cause analysis, contribute to modernization projects, and maintain clear technical documentation, standards, and network diagrams.


**These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview**
* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Network Engineer in an enterprise or data center environment.
* Strong expertise with Cisco enterprise networking (Catalyst and/or Nexus), including Layer 2/3, VLANs, STP, HSRP/VRRP, QoS, ACLs, and NAT.
* Practical experience with dynamic routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
* Working experience managing Fortinet FortiGate or similar next‑generation firewalls, including VPNs and security policies.
* Experience supporting load balancers or application delivery controllers (ideally F5 BIG‑IP).
* Comfortable working in high\-pressure production environments, including maintenance windows and critical incidents.
* Clear communication skills and a collaborative, ownership‑driven mindset.


**It would be great if you had these too, but we’ll support you if you don’t**
* Experience working across multi\-site or global networks, and familiarity with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Exposure to automation or infrastructure\-as\-code tools (for example, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or APIs).

**About GoKwik**
 GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, powering merchants across checkout optimisation, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables 15,000\+ merchants globally, processes \~$2 billion in GMV, and is rapidly scaling across India, the UK, Europe, and the US. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments, GoKwik has raised $68 million in funding, including a $13 million growth round in June 2025, and is building AI\-powered infrastructure to shape the future of eCommerce.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer \- I, you'll build the backend systems that power millions of eCommerce transactions and experiences. From checkout and payments to RTO reduction and merchant\-facing products, you'll write production\-grade code, ship customer\-facing features, and work alongside experienced engineers to build scalable, reliable systems. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership early while developing deep technical expertise in distributed systems and modern backend engineering.

 At GoKwik, you'll build products that power thousands of merchants and millions of shoppers while working with a high\-calibre engineering team. description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\-year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Join a team that is passionate about using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making and create custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in the growth, success, and well\-being of our people to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging, to managing critical emergencies. Together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role is part of a broader enterprise initiative to establish a
 **Data Context Layer (DCL)** 
 — a foundational capability designed to provide consistent, reusable, and scalable context across enterprise data products.
   

  

 The DCL is intended to address challenges related to
 **data fragmentation, lack of shared semantics, and inconsistent interpretation of data across systems and products** 
 . It establishes a unified layer for representing context, relationships, and meaning, enabling downstream products to operate with greater consistency, interoperability, and intelligence.
   

  

 In addition, the DCL plays a critical role in enabling
 **agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise** 
 by providing the structured context and semantic grounding required for intelligent agents to operate reliably. This includes ensuring that agent\-driven workflows and decisions are based on
 **consistent, governed, and interpretable data context** 
 , reducing risks associated with fragmentation, ambiguity, and lack of control.
   

  

 Within this initiative, we are seeking a Scrum Master to support agile delivery teams building enterprise capabilities on
 **AWS cloud technologies** 
 and
 **TIMBR\-like tools** 
 . This role will help teams deliver platform, data, semantic, and context\-serving solutions efficiently by facilitating agile practices, removing impediments, and improving delivery flow across product, engineering, and architecture stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has experience supporting technical teams in complex enterprise environments and is comfortable working with cloud, data, and platform delivery teams. Familiarity with
 **data context, semantic systems, ontologies, agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering** 
 is preferred, as the teams may be delivering capabilities that support AI\-enabled and context\-driven use cases.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**What will you do**
* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support one or more technical teams delivering capabilities in AWS and/or TIMBR\-like environments.
* Help teams maintain a healthy delivery cadence and improve predictability, transparency, and throughput.
* Remove or escalate impediments that slow team progress.
* Partner with product owners, technical leads, architects, and stakeholders to ensure priorities are clear and execution stays aligned.
* Track and communicate delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and blockers.
* Coach teams on agile principles, continuous improvement, and effective collaboration.
* Support coordination across teams when work spans APIs, pipelines, platform infrastructure, semantic models, or context\-serving services.
* Help teams manage dependencies and release coordination in complex enterprise settings.
* Encourage clear definition of done, story readiness, and cross\-functional alignment.
* Support delivery of work that may involve agentic AI workflows, prompt\-related capabilities, and context engineering needs.


**Required Qualifications**
**What should you have**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, Delivery Lead, or similar role.
* Experience supporting technical teams in software, data, cloud, or platform environments.
* Strong facilitation, communication, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with engineers, product managers, architects, and stakeholders.
* Familiarity with AWS cloud technologies and/or technical platform delivery environments.
* Comfort working in complex, cross\-functional enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with data context, semantic systems, ontology\-driven platforms, or TIMBR\-like tools is a plus.
* Working knowledge of agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering concepts is preferred.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting teams delivering APIs, data pipelines, platform services, or AI\-enabled products.
* Familiarity with agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar.
* Experience working with multiple teams and dependency\-heavy programs.
* Background in enterprise data, cloud, or semantic technology initiatives.
* Experience with release planning, program coordination, and delivery metrics.
* Agile certifications such as CSM, PSM, or equivalent are a plus.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role means
   

  

* the team has a healthy and predictable delivery cadence
* blockers are identified and removed quickly
* stakeholders have clear visibility into progress and risks
* cross\-team dependencies are managed effectively
* the team continuously improves its ways of working
* delivery supports stable progress toward AWS/TIMBR\-based platform goals

**What We Look For**

You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. **The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 The Lead Scrum Master is responsible for driving Agile delivery excellence across distributed teams, ensuring predictable outcomes and high product quality. The role oversees cross‑functional dependencies, release management, and delivery metrics to ensure execution discipline.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**

title: Technical Document Writer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 You will develop accurate, user\-centric, and technically sound documentation for SCADA systems in wind turbine operations, supporting engineering, commissioning, operations, and maintenance teams.
   

  

 The role requires close collaboration with SCADA engineers, network architects, software developers, and field technicians to document highly technical content related to wind farm control systems, networking architecture, data acquisition, and remote monitoring. You will translate complex engineering concepts into clear and usable documentation, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with industry standards.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for SCADA software and network infrastructure
* Develop system architecture and topology diagrams
* Prepare network configuration guides (switches, routers, firewalls)
* Document communication protocols (e.g., IEC 60870\-5\-104, Modbus, OPC)
* Develop installation and commissioning manuals
* Define cybersecurity and access control procedures
* Document alarm handling and data logging processes
* Create end\-user and admin operation guides
* Develop assembly work instructions
* Prepare electrical work instructions and wiring routing for SCADA panels
* Work on product specifications and engineering circuit drawings
* Manage BoM and components documentation
* Translate complex engineering concepts into clear documentation for technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (SCADA engineers, software developers, OT/IT teams, vendors) to gather source content
* Use documentation tools such as MS Office, Excel, Visio, Markdown, LaTeX, XML/DITA, and version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Ensure consistency in format, terminology, and compliance with industry standards and company style guidelines
* Regularly update documentation based on system upgrades, regulatory changes, and new deployments


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 to 6 years of experience
* Experience as a technical writer in the energy, automation, or SCADA domain
* Solid understanding of SCADA systems, industrial networking, and data acquisition principles
* Familiarity with wind turbine operations, control systems, and remote monitoring tools
* Strong grasp of networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, IP routing)
* Proficiency in creating structured technical documents using tools like MS Office, Excel, Visio, Xmetal, LaTeX, Markdown, or Sphinx
* Experience working in Agile engineering environments and interpreting technical drawings and network schematics using NX software / SEE Electrical software


**About The Team**
 You will be part of a collaborative and cross\-functional team supporting SCADA systems and wind energy solutions. The team works closely across engineering, software, and operations functions to ensure accurate documentation and smooth system deployment.
   

  

 The environment encourages knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and high\-quality documentation practices, enabling teams to effectively operate and maintain wind turbine systems while contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Gamesa?**
 Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are always looking for dedicated individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation.
   

  

 Empowering our people https://www.siemensgamesa.com/sustainability/employees
   

  

 How do you imagine the future? https://youtu.be/12Sm678tjuY
   

  

 Our global team is on the front line of tackling the climate crisis, reducing carbon emissions \- the greatest challenge we face.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
   

  

 Senior Technical Writer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru \& Chennai, India
   

  

**Department:** 
 Technical Communication Center of Excellence
   

  

**Company:** 
 Xylem Water Solutions India Private Limited, Global Capability Center, Bangalore
   

  

**About Xylem**
 Xylem is a leading global water technology company committed to solving the world’s most challenging water issues through innovation. Our mission is to enable sustainable, efficient water use and management for communities, industries, and the environment.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Senior Technical Writer at Xylem, you will be part of the Global Technical Communication Center of Excellence, responsible for developing world\-class customer documentation (Hardware/Software). You will author and manage content within a Component Content Management System (CCMS), collaborating closely with Project Coordinators and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) globally. Your work will support customers of Xylem products and systems through clear, accurate, and user\-focused documentation such as Installation and Operation Instructions, Service Manuals, and other technical publications.
   

  

 As you grow in this role, you will have opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement projects, process optimization, and training initiatives within Xylem’s documentation ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Technical Communication Center Of Excellence**
 A global team of technical information specialists responsible for developing customer product information across Xylem’s product portfolio. The team focuses on intelligent content reuse using XML\-based technologies, ensuring all publications are customer\-centric, reusable, and globally consistent across multiple outputs, channels, and languages.
   

  

 Prominent collaterals include Installation and Operation Instructions, Datasheets, Quick Guides, UI Guides, and UX Guides, Technical specifications etc.
   

  

 The team consists of a Content Development (Production) Team, a Localization Team, and a Documentation Systems Team.
   

  

**About The Team In Bengaluru \& Chennai (GCC)**
 The Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru \& Chennai serves as a shared service; resources supporting Xylem’s global product portfolio — including pumps, turbines, monitoring and control systems, and water analysis equipment. The team contributes to product design, development, testing, and technical documentation to deliver innovative and reliable water technology solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Content Development
   

  

* Develop reusable, structured technical content aligned with Xylem’s authoring guidelines, information model, and style guide.
* Conduct task analysis (TA) and prepare annotated topic lists (ATL).
* Create and maintain Topics, Chaptermaps, Bookmaps, and metadata within the CCMS.
* Produce and maintain illustrations, graphics, and photo\-realistic renderings.
* Ensure the completion of review cycle and software\-assisted checks for grammar, style, and terminology.
* Initiate translation requests and coordinate translation reviews.
* Communicate release updates to stakeholders via designated channels.
* Contribute to the development of the CCMS structure, templates, and information model.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and content governance.


**Required Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Aeronautical, Computer Science, or equivalent field).


**Experience**
* 4–6 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer (Senior level) in an international, English\-language environment.
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Basic experience creating technical illustrations in vector or raster formats.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

 Core Skills
   

  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Detail\-oriented, structured, and dependable on meeting deadlines.
* Effective communicator with global, cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE) and style guides such as the Microsoft or Chicago Manual of Style.
* Understanding of DDLC, SDLC, and Agile workflows.
* Knowledge of single sourcing, metadata management, and conditional profiling.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in DITA XML and CCMS platforms such as Astoria On\-Demand or AEM.
* Skilled in XML editors such as Oxygen XML Editor or Arbortext Editor.
* Experience with terminology and content quality tools such as Acrolinx.
* Proficiency with illustration tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Creo Illustrate, Keyshot).
* Experience with collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Understanding of content publishing pipelines and localization workflows.
* Working knowledge of XML\-based formats and related technologies (XQuery, metadata tagging).
* Interest in GenAI and automation using Python or similar programming languages is desirable.


 Assessment Process
   

  

* Candidates will complete a writing and structuring test to demonstrate technical English and content organization skills.
* Successful candidates will advance to subsequent interview rounds with technical and hiring teams


 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

* Prepare process maps, gap analyses, and target operating models.
* Recommend automation and digitalisation opportunities.
* Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Coordinate business validation and sign\-off activities.
* Ensure delivered solutions meet business objectives.
* Maintain project documentation and requirement traceability.
* Ensure compliance with governance and change management standards.
* Support audit and regulatory enquiries where required.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Years of Business Analysis experience.
* Experience within Banking, Wealth Management, Private Banking, or Financial Services environments.
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation and analysis.
* Experience preparing BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and use cases.
* Strong process mapping, gap analysis, impact assessment, and data analysis skills.
* Experience coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Domain expertise in one or more of the following:
+ Client Onboarding
+ KYC / AML
+ Broking \& Trading
+ Wealth Management
+ Portfolio Management Services (PMS)
+ Capital Markets
+ Private Banking
+ Client Lifecycle Management

* Knowledge of SQL and data analysis.
* Understanding of API and system integration concepts.
* Good understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Experience working in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Proficiency in JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Excel, and PowerPoint.


**Desirable Skills / Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA, CFA, FRM, CBAP, or equivalent professional certification.
* Experience with Private Banking or Wealth Management platforms.
* Experience with client onboarding systems and digital onboarding journeys.
* Experience with broking and trading platforms.
* Knowledge of SEBI and RBI regulatory initiatives.
* Experience with investment products and portfolio reporting.
* Experience delivering end\-to\-end projects in Agile environments.

* Business Analysis
* Requirements Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Process Analysis
* Business Process Re\-engineering
* Regulatory Change Management
* Data Analysis
* Agile Delivery
* Analytical Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Communication and Presentation Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Collaboration and Leadership


 Job location is Mumbai.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.

 their entire commerce experience — from discovery to checkout — runs on Shopify, and we're looking for a Full Stack Developer to own and elevate it.

**About The Role**

This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.
   

  

 \#BetterDaysStartNow
   

  

 The Master Data Analyst is responsible for the hands\-on technical execution of master data management activities. Working under the direction of the Master Data Lead, this role pulls, inspects, transforms, and maintains data to support lead\-to\-account resolution, account hygiene, and governance rule implementation. This is a role focused on data processing, exception management, and system\-level support.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
   

  

* Develops, inspects, mines, transforms, and models data to support master data governance and lead\-to\-account resolution processes
* Execute data pulls and compile datasets needed for rule validation, exception review, and quality monitoring
* Manage exception queues, flagging records that cannot be auto\-resolved for escalation to the Master Data Lead
* Implement and configure business rules in CRM/MDM systems as defined by the Master Data Lead
* Conduct data quality checks to verify accuracy of account matching, merging, and creation
* Maintain analytical systems and reporting to track match rates, duplicate volumes, and exception trends
* Manages all aspects of end\-to\-end data processing utilizing customized report building functions of systems
* Conducts statistical analysis on data and information to ensure correct predictive forecasting or classification
* Support ongoing data cleansing and deduplication efforts across customer master data
* Act as a liaison between the Master Data Lead and technical/IT teams for system changes or enhancements
* Document technical processes and maintain SOPs for recurring data tasks


 Specialist Career Stream
   

  

 Typically an individual contributor with responsibility in a professional discipline or specialty. Delivers and/or manages projects assigned and works with other stakeholders to achieve desired results. May act as a mentor to colleagues or may direct the work of other lower level professionals. The majority of time is spent delivering and overseeing the projects, from design to implementation \- while adhering to policies, using specialized knowledge and skills normally acquired through advanced education.
   

  

 Differentiating Factors
   

  

* Autonomy: Entry\-level individual contributor on a project or work team. Works with close supervision.
* Organizational Impact: Delivers work of limited scope, typically smaller, less complex projects or related activities.
* Innovation and Complexity: Identifies, defines and addresses problems that are not immediately evident but typically not difficult or complex. Makes minor changes in systems and processes to solve problems.
* Communication and Influence: Communicates primarily with internal contacts within immediate group. Contacts others to gather, confirm and convey information.
* Leadership and Talent Management: N/A – job at this level is focused on self\-development.


**Required Knowledge And Experience**
 Requires broad theoretical job knowledge typically obtained through advanced education.
   

  

 Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R.
   

  

* 214\.2(h)(4\)(iii)(A), 0 years of experience required.


**Additionally Required**
* Working knowledge of data management concepts, data pulls, transformations, quality checks
* Proficiency in SQL/Databricks; familiarity with data query tools (SQL, Power Query, or similar)
* Proficiency in Power BI for reporting, dashboards, and data quality monitoring
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to follow documented processes and business rules with consistency
* Clear written communication skills for documentation and status reporting


**Preferred**
* Experience with Salesforce, SAP, or MDM platforms
* Exposure to data quality or deduplication processes
* Familiarity with Microsoft Visio or process documentation tools
* Experience in medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare industry


**Physical Job Requirements**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
   

  

**Benefits \& Compensation**
**MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package**
 At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.
